----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_arch.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Architecture Notes
     3	 * 
     4	 * CRITICAL: There are TWO distinct execution environments:
     5	 * 
     6	 * 1. VALIDATION HARNESS (Test Environment)
     7	 *    - Flat memory buffer (deterministic, no hardware)
     8	 *    - No PiStorm backend
     9	 *    - Pure 68000 instruction semantics
    10	 *    - ProcessorTests JSON → flat RAM → Musashi/JIT → compare state
    11	 * 
    12	 * 2. REAL EMULATOR (PiStorm Runtime)
    13	 *    - PiStorm backend (src/pistorm/backend.*)
    14	 *    - Real Amiga memory map, MMU, chipset
    15	 *    - Function codes, bus behavior, timing
    16	 *    - JIT → m68k_read/write → PiStorm backend → Amiga memory
    17	 * 
    18	 * THESE MUST NOT BE MIXED.
    19	 * 
    20	 * The validation harness exists to validate instruction semantics
    21	 * in isolation from hardware complexity.
    22	 * 
    23	 * The real emulator integrates the validated JIT with actual hardware.
    24	 */
    25	
    26	#ifndef JIT_ARCH_H
    27	#define JIT_ARCH_H
    28	
    29	/* ======================================================================== */
    30	/* ====================== Environment Detection =========================== */
    31	/* ======================================================================== */
    32	
    33	/* 
    34	 * JIT_ENV_TEST     - Validation harness with flat memory
    35	 * JIT_ENV_PISTORM  - Real emulator with PiStorm backend
    36	 * 
    37	 * Define JIT_ENV_TEST when building for ProcessorTests validation.
    38	 * Define JIT_ENV_PISTORM (or neither) for real emulator.
    39	 */
    40	
    41	#if defined(JIT_ENV_TEST)
    42	    /* Validation harness - flat memory model */
    43	    #include "jit_mem_test.h"
    44	#elif defined(JIT_ENV_PISTORM) || !defined(JIT_ENV_TEST)
    45	    /* Real emulator - PiStorm backend */
    46	    #include "jit_mem_pistorm.h"
    47	#else
    48	    #error "JIT environment not defined - set JIT_ENV_TEST or JIT_ENV_PISTORM"
    49	#endif
    50	
    51	/* ======================================================================== */
    52	/* ====================== Common JIT Interface ============================ */
    53	/* ======================================================================== */
    54	
    55	/* 
    56	 * The JIT translator uses these abstract memory operations.
    57	 * The actual implementation depends on the environment.
    58	 * 
    59	 * In TEST mode: direct access to flat test memory
    60	 * In PISTORM mode: calls to PiStorm backend
    61	 */
    62	
    63	/* Read from 68000 memory space */
    64	int jit_mem_read8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint8_t *value);
    65	int jit_mem_read16(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint16_t *value);
    66	int jit_mem_read32(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint32_t *value);
    67	
    68	/* Write to 68000 memory space */
    69	int jit_mem_write8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t value, uint8_t fc);
    70	int jit_mem_write16(uint32_t addr, uint16_t value, uint8_t fc);
    71	int jit_mem_write32(uint32_t addr, uint32_t value, uint8_t fc);
    72	
    73	/* Fetch instruction from PC (handles prefetch buffer in real hardware) */
    74	uint16_t jit_fetch_word(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc);
    75	uint32_t jit_fetch_long(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc);
    76	
    77	/* ======================================================================== */
    78	/* ====================== Function Codes ================================== */
    79	/* ======================================================================== */
    80	
    81	#define JIT_FC_USER_DATA        1
    82	#define JIT_FC_USER_PROGRAM     2
    83	#define JIT_FC_SUPERVISOR_DATA  5
    84	#define JIT_FC_SUPERVISOR_PROG  6
    85	#define JIT_FC_CPU_SPACE        7
    86	
    87	/* Helper to get FC from CPU state */
    88	static inline uint8_t jit_get_fc(int is_supervisor, int is_program)
    89	{
    90	    if (is_supervisor) {
    91	        return is_program ? JIT_FC_SUPERVISOR_PROG : JIT_FC_SUPERVISOR_DATA;
    92	    }
    93	    return is_program ? JIT_FC_USER_PROGRAM : JIT_FC_USER_DATA;
    94	}
    95	
    96	/* ======================================================================== */
    97	/* ====================== JIT Cache (Always Native) ======================= */
    98	/* ======================================================================== */
    99	
   100	/* 
   101	 * JIT compiled code cache is ALWAYS in native AArch64 memory.
   102	 * This is true for both TEST and PISTORM environments.
   103	 * 
   104	 * No byte swapping needed for JIT internal operations.
   105	 */
   106	
   107	static inline uint16_t jit_cache_read16(const uint8_t *cache, uint32_t offset)
   108	{
   109	    return *(uint16_t*)(cache + offset);
   110	}
   111	
   112	static inline uint32_t jit_cache_read32(const uint8_t *cache, uint32_t offset)
   113	{
   114	    return *(uint32_t*)(cache + offset);
   115	}
   116	
   117	static inline void jit_cache_write16(uint8_t *cache, uint32_t offset, uint16_t value)
   118	{
   119	    *(uint16_t*)(cache + offset) = value;
   120	}
   121	
   122	static inline void jit_cache_write32(uint8_t *cache, uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
   123	{
   124	    *(uint32_t*)(cache + offset) = value;
   125	}
   126	
   127	/* AArch64 byte-swap instructions for register operations */
   128	#define AARCH64_REV_Wd_Wn(Wd, Wn)  (0xDAC00C00 | ((Wn) << 5) | (Wd))
   129	#define AARCH64_REVH_Wd_Wn(Wd, Wn) (0xDAC00800 | ((Wn) << 5) | (Wd))
   130	
   131	#endif /* JIT_ARCH_H */


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_block.c -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Block Implementation - Unified Model
     3	 * 
     4	 * Conventions:
     5	 * - X19 holds pointer to m68ki_cpu state structure (callee-saved)
     6	 * - Translators append to emit context (no buffer allocation)
     7	 * - Single block builder manages instruction_count and code_ptr
     8	 */
     9	
    10	#include "jit.h"
    11	#include "jit_block.h"
    12	#include "jit_cache.h"
    13	#include "jit_translate.h"
    14	#include "jit_emit_aarch64.h"
    15	#include "jit_arch.h"
    16	#include "musashi/m68kcpu.h"
    17	#include "log.h"
    18	#include <stdio.h>
    19	#include <string.h>
    20	#include <stdlib.h>
    21	#include <stddef.h>
    22	
    23	/* Hash function for PC lookup */
    24	static inline uint32_t jit_hash_pc(uint32_t pc)
    25	{
    26	    uint32_t hash = pc * 2654435761u;
    27	    return (hash >> 16) & (JIT_HASH_SIZE - 1);
    28	}
    29	
    30	/* JIT Execution Logging */
    31	static int g_jit_log_enabled = -1;
    32	static uint32_t g_jit_log_pc_start = 0;
    33	static uint32_t g_jit_log_pc_end = 0;
    34	
    35	static void jit_log_init(void)
    36	{
    37	    if (g_jit_log_enabled < 0) {
    38	        const char* e = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_JIT_LOG");
    39	        g_jit_log_enabled = (e && atoi(e) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
    40	        if (g_jit_log_enabled) {
    41	            LOG_INFO("[JIT] Logging enabled\n");
    42	        }
    43	    }
    44	}
    45	
    46	static int jit_log_should_log_pc(uint32_t pc)
    47	{
    48	    jit_log_init();
    49	    if (!g_jit_log_enabled) return 0;
    50	    
    51	    /* Log specific PC ranges if set, otherwise log everything */
    52	    if (g_jit_log_pc_start || g_jit_log_pc_end) {
    53	        return (pc >= g_jit_log_pc_start && pc <= g_jit_log_pc_end);
    54	    }
    55	    return 1;
    56	}
    57	
    58	static void jit_log_block_compile(jit_block_t *block)
    59	{
    60	    if (!jit_log_should_log_pc(block->start_pc)) return;
    61	    
    62	    LOG_INFO("[JIT-COMPILE] Block PC=0x%08X end=0x%08X instrs=%u\n",
    63	             block->start_pc, block->end_pc, block->instruction_count);
    64	    
    65	    for (int i = 0; i < block->instruction_count; i++) {
    66	        uint16_t op = block->instructions[i].opcode;
    67	        const jit_opinfo_t *opinfo = jit_get_opinfo(op);
    68	        LOG_INFO("[JIT-COMPILE]   [%d] 0x%04X family=%u ext=%u flags=0x%02X\n",
    69	                 i, op, opinfo->family, block->instructions[i].ext_count, opinfo->flags);
    70	        
    71	        /* Log family=0 (illegal) opcodes with more detail */
    72	        if (opinfo->family == 0) {
    73	            LOG_INFO("[JIT-ILLEGAL] Opcode 0x%04X at PC=0x%08X classified as ILLEGAL\n",
    74	                     op, block->start_pc + (i * 2));
    75	        }
    76	    }
    77	}
    78	
    79	/* Dump generated AArch64 code for debugging */
    80	static void jit_dump_aarch64_code(jit_block_t *block)
    81	{
    82	    if (block->code_ptr == NULL || block->code_size == 0) {
    83	        return;
    84	    }
    85	    
    86	    fprintf(stderr, "\n[AA64-DUMP] Block PC=0x%08X code=%p size=%zu\n", 
    87	            block->start_pc, (void*)block->code_ptr, block->code_size);
    88	    
    89	    uint32_t *code = (uint32_t *)block->code_ptr;
    90	    int words = block->code_size / 4;
    91	    
    92	    for (int i = 0; i < words && i < 64; i++) {
    93	        fprintf(stderr, "  [%02d] 0x%08X\n", i, code[i]);
    94	    }
    95	    
    96	    if (words > 64) {
    97	        fprintf(stderr, "  ... (%d more words)\n", words - 64);
    98	    }
    99	}
   100	
   101	static void jit_log_block_execute(jit_block_t *block, struct m68ki_cpu_core *cpu)
   102	{
   103	    if (!jit_log_should_log_pc(block->start_pc)) return;
   104	    
   105	    LOG_INFO("[JIT-EXEC] Block PC=0x%08X code=%p\n", block->start_pc, (void*)block->code_ptr);
   106	    LOG_INFO("[JIT-EXEC]   SR=0x%04X A7=0x%08X PC=0x%08X\n",
   107	             (cpu->s_flag << 13) | (cpu->m_flag << 11) | (cpu->int_mask << 8) |
   108	             ((cpu->x_flag >> 4) << 4) | ((cpu->n_flag >> 4) << 3) |
   109	             ((!cpu->not_z_flag) << 2) | ((cpu->v_flag >> 6) << 1) | (cpu->c_flag >> 8),
   110	             cpu->dar[15], cpu->pc);
   111	    
   112	    /* Log instructions in block */
   113	    for (int i = 0; i < block->instruction_count; i++) {
   114	        uint16_t op = block->instructions[i].opcode;
   115	        const jit_opinfo_t *opinfo = jit_get_opinfo(op);
   116	        LOG_INFO("[JIT-EXEC]   [%d] 0x%04X family=%u ext=%u\n",
   117	                 i, op, opinfo->family, block->instructions[i].ext_count);
   118	    }
   119	}
   120	
   121	static void jit_log_block_done(jit_block_t *block, struct m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, int cycles)
   122	{
   123	    if (!jit_log_should_log_pc(block->start_pc)) return;
   124	    
   125	    LOG_INFO("[JIT-DONE] Block PC=0x%08X cycles=%d new_PC=0x%08X\n",
   126	             block->start_pc, cycles, cpu->pc);
   127	}
   128	
   129	static inline int jit_family_codegen_supported(uint8_t family)
   130	{
   131	    /* Let translator dispatch decide support; only hard-trap families are denied here. */
   132	    return (family != JIT_FAMILY_ILLEGAL &&
   133	            family != JIT_FAMILY_LINE_A &&
   134	            family != JIT_FAMILY_LINE_F);
   135	}
   136	
   137	jit_block_t *jit_block_alloc(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc)
   138	{
   139	    jit_block_t *block = (jit_block_t *)calloc(1, sizeof(jit_block_t));
   140	    if (block == NULL) {
   141	        return NULL;
   142	    }
   143	    
   144	    block->start_pc = pc;
   145	    block->flags = JIT_BLOCK_VALID;
   146	    
   147	    return block;
   148	}
   149	
   150	void jit_block_free(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   151	{
   152	    if (block == NULL) {
   153	        return;
   154	    }
   155	    
   156	    /* Decrement interpret block count if applicable */
   157	    if (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   158	        if (g_jit.stats.interpret_blocks_count > 0) {
   159	            g_jit.stats.interpret_blocks_count--;
   160	        }
   161	    }
   162	    
   163	    if (block->code_ptr != NULL && block->code_size > 0) {
   164	        jit_cache_free(jit, block->code_ptr, block->code_size);
   165	    }
   166	    
   167	    free(block);
   168	}
   169	
   170	int jit_block_translate(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   171	{
   172	    uint32_t pc = block->start_pc;
   173	    int instr_count = 0;
   174	    bool end_block = false;
   175	    uint8_t fetch_fc;
   176	    
   177	    if (!jit || !block || !jit->cpu) {
   178	        LOG_ERROR("[CPU] m68xkcpu: jit_block_translate invalid context\n");
   179	        return -1;
   180	    }
   181	
   182	    fetch_fc = jit_get_fc(jit->cpu->s_flag ? 1 : 0, 1);
   183	    
   184	    while (!end_block && instr_count < JIT_MAX_BLOCK_INSTRUCTIONS) {
   185	        const jit_opinfo_t *opinfo;
   186	        uint16_t opcode;
   187	        uint16_t ext_words[4] = {0};
   188	        int ext_count = 0;
   189	        
   190	        opcode = jit_fetch_word(pc, fetch_fc);
   191	        opinfo = jit_get_opinfo(opcode);
   192	
   193	        if (!jit_family_codegen_supported(opinfo->family)) {
   194	            block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
   195	            end_block = true;
   196	        }
   197	        
   198	        if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_ILLEGAL ||
   199	            opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_LINE_A ||
   200	            opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_LINE_F) {
   201	            end_block = true;
   202	            block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_TRAP;
   203	        }
   204	        
   205	        ext_count = opinfo->ext_words;
   206	        
   207	        /* Mark BSR as interpret-only (not yet implemented) */
   208	        /* BRA and BCC are implemented and will be compiled */
   209	        if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BSR) {
   210	            block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
   211	            end_block = true;
   212	        }
   213	        
   214	        /* BRA/BCC end the block but will be compiled */
   215	        if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BRA ||
   216	            opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BCC) {
   217	            end_block = true;
   218	        }
   219	        
   220	        if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_JMP || opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_JSR) {
   221	            uint8_t ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   222	            if (ea_mode == 7 && (opcode & 0x7) == 0) {
   223	                ext_count = 1;
   224	            } else if (ea_mode == 7 && (opcode & 0x7) == 1) {
   225	                ext_count = 2;
   226	            } else if (ea_mode == 5) {
   227	                ext_count = 1;
   228	            }
   229	        }
   230	        
   231	        for (int i = 0; i < ext_count && i < 4; i++) {
   232	            ext_words[i] = jit_fetch_word(pc + 2 + (uint32_t)(i * 2), fetch_fc);
   233	        }
   234	        
   235	        block->instructions[instr_count].opcode = opcode;
   236	        block->instructions[instr_count].ext_count = ext_count;
   237	        memcpy(block->instructions[instr_count].ext_words, ext_words, sizeof(ext_words));
   238	        
   239	        if (opinfo->flags & JIT_OPF_BLOCK_END) {
   240	            end_block = true;
   241	            
   242	            if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BRA ||
   243	                opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BCC ||
   244	                opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_BSR) {
   245	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_BRANCH;
   246	            } else if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_RTS) {
   247	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_RTS;
   248	            } else if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_RTE) {
   249	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_RTE;
   250	            } else if (opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_JMP ||
   251	                       opinfo->family == JIT_FAMILY_JSR) {
   252	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_JMP;
   253	            } else if (opinfo->flags & JIT_OPF_MAY_TRAP) {
   254	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_TRAP;
   255	            }
   256	        }
   257	        
   258	        if (opinfo->flags & JIT_OPF_PRIVILEGED) {
   259	            end_block = true;
   260	            block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_TRAP;
   261	        }
   262	        
   263	        pc += 2 + (ext_count * 2);
   264	        instr_count++;
   265	    }
   266	    
   267	    block->instruction_count = instr_count;
   268	    block->end_pc = pc;
   269	    block->ends_block = end_block ? 1 : 0;
   270	    
   271	    jit_log_block_compile(block);
   272	    
   273	    return 0;
   274	}
   275	
   276	int jit_block_emit(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   277	{
   278	    uint8_t tmp_code[JIT_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE];
   279	    uint8_t *code_start;
   280	    size_t final_size;
   281	    
   282	    if (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   283	        return 0;
   284	    }
   285	
   286	    /* Initialize emitter context - translators append to this */
   287	    jit_emit_context_t emit;
   288	    jit_emit_init(&emit, tmp_code, JIT_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE);
   289	    
   290	    /* Emit prologue - X19 should already contain &m68ki_cpu from caller */
   291	    jit_emit_prologue(&emit);
   292	    
   293	    /* Emit each instruction by calling translator */
   294	    for (int i = 0; i < block->instruction_count; i++) {
   295	        uint16_t opcode = block->instructions[i].opcode;
   296	        const jit_opinfo_t *opinfo = jit_get_opinfo(opcode);
   297	        uint16_t *ext_words = block->instructions[i].ext_words;
   298	        int ext_count = block->instructions[i].ext_count;
   299	        
   300	        jit_translator_fn translator = NULL;
   301	        
   302	        /* Select translator based on family */
   303	        switch (opinfo->family) {
   304	            case JIT_FAMILY_NOP:
   305	                translator = jit_translate_nop;
   306	                break;
   307	            case JIT_FAMILY_MOVEQ:
   308	                translator = jit_translate_moveq;
   309	                break;
   310	            case JIT_FAMILY_MOVE:
   311	                translator = jit_translate_move;
   312	                break;
   313	            case JIT_FAMILY_ADD:
   314	                translator = jit_translate_add;
   315	                break;
   316	            case JIT_FAMILY_ADDQ:
   317	                translator = jit_translate_addq;
   318	                break;
   319	            case JIT_FAMILY_SUB:
   320	                translator = jit_translate_sub;
   321	                break;
   322	            case JIT_FAMILY_SUBQ:
   323	                translator = jit_translate_subq;
   324	                break;
   325	            case JIT_FAMILY_CMP:
   326	            case JIT_FAMILY_CMPI:
   327	            case JIT_FAMILY_CMPM:
   328	                translator = jit_translate_cmp;
   329	                break;
   330	            case JIT_FAMILY_AND:
   331	            case JIT_FAMILY_ANDI:
   332	            case JIT_FAMILY_OR:
   333	            case JIT_FAMILY_ORI:
   334	            case JIT_FAMILY_EOR:
   335	            case JIT_FAMILY_EORI:
   336	                translator = jit_translate_logic;
   337	                break;
   338	            case JIT_FAMILY_BRA:
   339	            case JIT_FAMILY_BCC:
   340	                translator = jit_translate_branch;
   341	                break;
   342	            case JIT_FAMILY_BSR:
   343	                translator = jit_translate_bsr;
   344	                break;
   345	            case JIT_FAMILY_RTS:
   346	                translator = jit_translate_rts;
   347	                break;
   348	            case JIT_FAMILY_JSR:
   349	                translator = jit_translate_jsr;
   350	                break;
   351	            case JIT_FAMILY_JMP:
   352	                translator = jit_translate_jmp;
   353	                break;
   354	            case JIT_FAMILY_MOVEC:
   355	                translator = jit_translate_movec;
   356	                break;
   357	            case JIT_FAMILY_EXTB:
   358	            case JIT_FAMILY_EXT:
   359	                translator = jit_translate_extb;
   360	                break;
   361	            case JIT_FAMILY_LEA:
   362	                translator = jit_translate_lea;
   363	                break;
   364	            case JIT_FAMILY_CLR:
   365	            case JIT_FAMILY_TST:
   366	            case JIT_FAMILY_BTST:
   367	            case JIT_FAMILY_BSET:
   368	            case JIT_FAMILY_BCLR:
   369	            case JIT_FAMILY_BCHG:
   370	                translator = jit_translate_misc;
   371	                break;
   372	            default:
   373	                /* Unimplemented family */
   374	                LOG_INFO("[JIT-FALLBACK] Unsupported family=%u opcode=0x%04X PC=0x%08X\n",
   375	                         opinfo->family, opcode, block->start_pc);
   376	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
   377	                return 0;
   378	        }
   379	        
   380	        block->host_offsets[i] = (uint16_t)emit.offset;
   381	
   382	        if (translator) {
   383	            jit_translate_context_t tctx = {
   384	                .jit = jit,
   385	                .block = block,
   386	                .emit = &emit,
   387	                .opcode = opcode,
   388	                .ext_words = ext_words,
   389	                .ext_count = ext_count,
   390	                .instruction_index = (uint16_t)i,
   391	            };
   392	            if (translator(&tctx) < 0) {
   393	                /* Translator failed - mark block for interpretation and return error
   394	                 * so the block is NOT cached as executable code */
   395	                block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
   396	                return -1; /* Signal compilation failure - caller will use Musashi */
   397	            }
   398	        }
   399	        
   400	        if (emit.error) {
   401	            LOG_ERROR("[JIT-EMIT] Buffer overflow at instruction %d PC=0x%08X\n", i, block->start_pc);
   402	            return -1;
   403	        }
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    block->host_offsets[block->instruction_count] = (uint16_t)emit.offset;
   407	    
   408	    /* Emit epilogue */
   409	    jit_emit_epilogue(&emit);
   410	    
   411	    final_size = (emit.offset + 15u) & ~15u;
   412	    
   413	    code_start = jit_cache_alloc(jit, final_size);
   414	    if (code_start == NULL) {
   415	        LOG_ERROR("[CPU] m68xkcpu: code cache exhausted\n");
   416	        return -1;
   417	    }
   418	    
   419	    memcpy(code_start, tmp_code, emit.offset);
   420	    jit_cache_flush(jit, code_start, emit.offset);
   421	    
   422	    block->code_ptr = code_start;
   423	    block->code_size = final_size;
   424	    
   425	    /* DEBUG: Dump generated code */
   426	    jit_dump_aarch64_code(block);
   427	    
   428	    return 0;
   429	}
   430	
   431	int jit_block_execute(jit_block_t *block, int max_cycles)
   432	{
   433	    if (block == NULL || block->code_ptr == NULL) {
   434	        return -1;
   435	    }
   436	    
   437	    extern struct m68ki_cpu_core m68ki_cpu;
   438	    
   439	    jit_log_block_execute(block, &m68ki_cpu);
   440	    
   441	    typedef int (*jit_func_t)(int cycles);
   442	    jit_func_t func = (jit_func_t)block->code_ptr;
   443	
   444	#if defined(__aarch64__)
   445	    /* JIT ABI contract: compiled blocks expect CPU state pointer in X19. */
   446	    asm volatile("mov x19, %0" : : "r"(&m68ki_cpu) : "x19");
   447	#endif
   448	    
   449	    extern jit_context_t g_jit;
   450	    g_jit.current_block = block;
   451	    int cycles = func(max_cycles);
   452	    g_jit.current_block = NULL;
   453	    
   454	    /* Sync PC from CPU state after execution */
   455	    g_jit.current_pc = (uint32_t)m68ki_cpu.pc;
   456	    
   457	    jit_log_block_done(block, &m68ki_cpu, cycles);
   458	    
   459	    return cycles;
   460	}
   461	
   462	void jit_block_invalidate(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   463	{
   464	    if (block == NULL) {
   465	        return;
   466	    }
   467	    
   468	    block->flags &= ~JIT_BLOCK_VALID;
   469	    
   470	    if (block->code_ptr != NULL) {
   471	        jit_cache_free(jit, block->code_ptr, block->code_size);
   472	        block->code_ptr = NULL;
   473	        block->code_size = 0;
   474	    }
   475	}
   476	
   477	void jit_block_dump(jit_block_t *block)
   478	{
   479	    if (block == NULL) {
   480	        printf("Block: NULL\n");
   481	        return;
   482	    }
   483	    
   484	    printf("Block @ 0x%08X:\n", block->start_pc);
   485	    printf("  End PC:     0x%08X\n", block->end_pc);
   486	    printf("  Code ptr:   %p\n", (void *)block->code_ptr);
   487	    printf("  Code size:  %zu bytes\n", block->code_size);
   488	    printf("  Instrs:     %u\n", block->instruction_count);
   489	    printf("  Flags:      0x%04X\n", block->flags);
   490	    printf("  Ends block: %s\n", block->ends_block ? "yes" : "no");
   491	    
   492	    printf("  Instructions:\n");
   493	    for (int i = 0; i < block->instruction_count; i++) {
   494	        printf("    [%02d] 0x%04X", i, block->instructions[i].opcode);
   495	        if (block->instructions[i].ext_count > 0) {
   496	            printf(" ext=%u", block->instructions[i].ext_count);
   497	        }
   498	        printf("\n");
   499	    }
   500	}
   501	
   502	/* ============================================================================
   503	 * Translator implementations (single block-based path)
   504	 * ============================================================================ */
   505	
   506	int jit_translate_nop(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   507	{
   508	    /* NOP - no code to emit */
   509	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   510	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   511	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   512	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   513	    (void)ctx; (void)opcode; (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
   514	    return 0;
   515	}
   516	
   517	int jit_translate_moveq(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   518	{
   519	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   520	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   521	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   522	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   523	    /* MOVEQ: 0111 dnnn dddddddd - move 8-bit immediate to Dn */
   524	    int dn = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   525	    int8_t imm = (int8_t)(opcode & 0xFF);
   526	    
   527	    /* Load immediate into temp register */
   528	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, (uint64_t)(int32_t)imm);
   529	    
   530	    /* Store to Dn */
   531	    jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dn);
   532	    
   533	    /* Increment PC by 2 (MOVEQ has no extension words) */
   534	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2);
   535	    
   536	    (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
   537	    return 0;
   538	}
   539	
   540	int jit_translate_move(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   541	{
   542	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   543	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   544	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   545	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   546	    /* MOVE: 0001 size(2) dst_mode(3) dst_reg(3) src_mode(3) src_reg(3)
   547	     * Bits 15-12 = 0001, Bits 11-9 = size, Bits 8-6 = dst EA, Bits 5-3 = dst reg,
   548	     * Bits 2-0 = src mode, but src mode is in bits 5-3 actually
   549	     * Correct: bits 14-12 = size, 11-9 = dst mode, 8-6 = dst reg, 5-3 = src mode, 2-0 = src reg
   550	     */
   551	    uint8_t size = (opcode >> 12) & 0x3;  /* 0=byte, 1=word, 2=long */
   552	    uint8_t dst_mode = (opcode >> 6) & 0x7;
   553	    uint8_t dst_reg = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   554	    uint8_t src_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   555	    uint8_t src_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   556	    
   557	    /* For now, implement common Dn/An modes */
   558	    if (dst_mode == 0) {
   559	        /* MOVE to Dn */
   560	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   561	            /* MOVE <Dn>, <Dn> */
   562	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   563	            if (size == 0) {
   564	                /* Byte: zero-extend using LSL/ASR */
   565	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   566	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ASR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   567	            } else if (size == 1) {
   568	                /* Word: zero-extend using LSL/ASR */
   569	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   570	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ASR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   571	            }
   572	            /* Long: already 32-bit */
   573	            jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   574	        } else if (src_mode == 2) {
   575	            /* MOVE (An), Dn */
   576	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   577	            if (size == 0) {
   578	                jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   579	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   580	            } else if (size == 1) {
   581	                jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   582	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   583	            } else {
   584	                jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   585	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   586	            }
   587	        } else if (src_mode == 3) {
   588	            /* MOVE (An)+, Dn */
   589	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   590	            int incr = (size == 0) ? 1 : (size == 1) ? 2 : 4;
   591	            if (size == 0) {
   592	                jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   593	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   594	            } else if (size == 1) {
   595	                jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   596	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   597	            } else {
   598	                jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   599	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   600	            }
   601	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   602	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, incr);
   603	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   604	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   605	        } else if (src_mode == 5) {
   606	            /* MOVE d16(An), Dn */
   607	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
   608	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   609	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, (uint64_t)(int32_t)disp);
   610	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   611	            if (size == 0) {
   612	                jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   613	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   614	            } else if (size == 1) {
   615	                jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   616	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   617	            } else {
   618	                jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
   619	                jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   620	            }
   621	        } else {
   622	            return -1; /* Fallback for other modes */
   623	        }
   624	    } else if (dst_mode == 1) {
   625	        /* MOVE to An - sign extend for word/byte */
   626	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   627	            /* MOVE Dn, An */
   628	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   629	            if (size == 0) {
   630	                /* Byte: sign-extend using LSL/ASR */
   631	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   632	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ASR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   633	            } else if (size == 1) {
   634	                /* Word: sign-extend using LSL/ASR */
   635	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   636	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ASR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   637	            }
   638	            /* Long: already 32-bit, zero-extends to 64-bit in AArch64 */
   639	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   640	        } else {
   641	            return -1; /* Fallback */
   642	        }
   643	    } else if (dst_mode == 2) {
   644	        /* MOVE Dn, (An) */
   645	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   646	            /* MOVE Dn, (An) */
   647	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   648	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   649	            if (size == 0) {
   650	                jit_emit_call_write8(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   651	            } else if (size == 1) {
   652	                jit_emit_call_write16(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   653	            } else {
   654	                jit_emit_call_write32(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   655	            }
   656	        } else {
   657	            return -1;
   658	        }
   659	    } else if (dst_mode == 3) {
   660	        /* MOVE Dn, (An)+ */
   661	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   662	            int incr = (size == 0) ? 1 : (size == 1) ? 2 : 4;
   663	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   664	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   665	            if (size == 0) {
   666	                jit_emit_call_write8(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   667	            } else if (size == 1) {
   668	                jit_emit_call_write16(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   669	            } else {
   670	                jit_emit_call_write32(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   671	            }
   672	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   673	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, incr);
   674	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0));
   675	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   676	        } else {
   677	            return -1;
   678	        }
   679	    } else if (dst_mode == 5) {
   680	        /* MOVE Dn, d16(An) */
   681	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   682	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[(src_mode == 5) ? 1 : 0];
   683	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
   684	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
   685	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, (uint64_t)(int32_t)disp);
   686	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2));
   687	            if (size == 0) {
   688	                jit_emit_call_write8(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   689	            } else if (size == 1) {
   690	                jit_emit_call_write16(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   691	            } else {
   692	                jit_emit_call_write32(ctx, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1);
   693	            }
   694	        } else {
   695	            return -1;
   696	        }
   697	    } else {
   698	        return -1; /* Fallback for other dst modes */
   699	    }
   700	    
   701	    /* Increment PC */
   702	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2 + ext_count * 2);
   703	    
   704	    (void)ext_count;
   705	    return 0;
   706	}
   707	
   708	int jit_translate_add(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   709	{
   710	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   711	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   712	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   713	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   714	    /* ADD decode:
   715	     * opmode bits 8..6:
   716	     *   000 ADD.B <ea>,Dn
   717	     *   001 ADD.W <ea>,Dn
   718	     *   010 ADD.L <ea>,Dn
   719	     *   100/101/110 ADD Dn,<ea> (not handled here yet)
   720	     */
   721	    uint8_t opmode = (opcode >> 6) & 0x7;
   722	    uint8_t dst_reg = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7; /* Dn when opmode <= 2 */
   723	    uint8_t src_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   724	    uint8_t src_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   725	    int incr;
   726	
   727	    /* Only ADD.<ea>,Dn path is handled here. */
   728	    if (opmode > 2) {
   729	        return -1;
   730	    }
   731	
   732	    /* Start with destination Dn. */
   733	    jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   734	
   735	    /* Load source operand into R1. */
   736	    if (src_mode == 0) {
   737	        /* ADD Dn,Dn */
   738	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, src_reg);
   739	    } else if (src_mode == 2) {
   740	        /* ADD (An),Dn */
   741	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   742	        if (opmode == 0) {
   743	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   744	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   745	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   746	        } else {
   747	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   748	        }
   749	    } else if (src_mode == 3) {
   750	        /* ADD (An)+,Dn */
   751	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   752	        if (opmode == 0) {
   753	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   754	            incr = (src_reg == 7) ? 2 : 1;
   755	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   756	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   757	            incr = 2;
   758	        } else {
   759	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   760	            incr = 4;
   761	        }
   762	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   763	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)incr);
   764	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   765	        jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   766	    } else if (src_mode == 5) {
   767	        /* ADD d16(An),Dn */
   768	        int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
   769	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   770	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)(int32_t)disp);
   771	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   772	        if (opmode == 0) {
   773	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   774	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   775	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   776	        } else {
   777	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   778	        }
   779	    } else {
   780	        return -1;
   781	    }
   782	
   783	    /* Width-normalize for byte/word operations before ADDS. */
   784	    if (opmode == 0) {
   785	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   786	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, 24));
   787	    } else if (opmode == 1) {
   788	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   789	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, 16));
   790	    }
   791	
   792	    /* Execute arithmetic and capture 68k flags from NZCV. */
   793	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADDS(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   794	    jit_emit_store_nzcv_flags(ctx, 0);
   795	
   796	    /* Shift back and merge for byte/word destination updates. */
   797	    if (opmode == 0) {
   798	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
   799	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R2, dst_reg);
   800	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, 0xFFFFFF00u);
   801	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   802	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
   803	    } else if (opmode == 1) {
   804	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
   805	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R2, dst_reg);
   806	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, 0xFFFF0000u);
   807	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   808	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
   809	    }
   810	
   811	    jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   812	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2 + ext_count * 2);
   813	    return 0;
   814	}
   815	
   816	int jit_translate_addq(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   817	{
   818	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   819	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   820	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   821	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   822	    /* ADDQ: #data, EA - data is 1-8 in bits 9-11 */
   823	    int data = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   824	    if (data == 0) data = 8;
   825	    
   826	    int ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   827	    int ea_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   828	    
   829	    if (ea_mode == 0) {
   830	        /* ADDQ #data, Dn */
   831	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
   832	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, (uint64_t)data);
   833	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADDS(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   834	        jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
   835	    } else {
   836	        return -1;
   837	    }
   838	    
   839	    /* Increment PC */
   840	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2);
   841	    
   842	    (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
   843	    return 0;
   844	}
   845	
   846	int jit_translate_sub(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   847	{
   848	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   849	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   850	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   851	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   852	    /* SUB: 1001 size(2) dst_mode(3) dst_reg(3) src_mode(3) src_reg(3) */
   853	    uint8_t size = (opcode >> 12) & 0x3;
   854	    uint8_t dst_mode = (opcode >> 6) & 0x7;
   855	    uint8_t dst_reg = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   856	    uint8_t src_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   857	    uint8_t src_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   858	    
   859	    /* SUB <ea>, Dn - most common form */
   860	    if (dst_mode == 0) {
   861	        /* SUB to Dn */
   862	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   863	        
   864	        if (src_mode == 0) {
   865	            /* SUB Dn, Dn */
   866	            jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, src_reg);
   867	        } else if (src_mode == 2) {
   868	            /* SUB (An), Dn */
   869	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, src_reg);
   870	            if (size == 0) {
   871	                jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   872	            } else if (size == 1) {
   873	                jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   874	            } else {
   875	                jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   876	            }
   877	        } else if (src_mode == 5) {
   878	            /* SUB d16(An), Dn */
   879	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
   880	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R1, src_reg);
   881	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, (uint64_t)(int32_t)disp);
   882	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2));
   883	            if (size == 0) {
   884	                jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   885	            } else if (size == 1) {
   886	                jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   887	            } else {
   888	                jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1);
   889	            }
   890	        } else {
   891	            return -1;
   892	        }
   893	        
   894	        /* Perform sub with flags */
   895	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUBS(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   896	        jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   897	    } else {
   898	        return -1;
   899	    }
   900	    
   901	    /* Increment PC */
   902	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2 + ext_count * 2);
   903	    
   904	    (void)ext_count;
   905	    return 0;
   906	}
   907	
   908	int jit_translate_subq(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   909	{
   910	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   911	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   912	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   913	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   914	    /* SUBQ: #data, EA - similar to ADDQ */
   915	    int data = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   916	    if (data == 0) data = 8;
   917	    
   918	    int ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   919	    int ea_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   920	    
   921	    if (ea_mode == 0) {
   922	        /* SUBQ #data, Dn */
   923	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
   924	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, (uint64_t)data);
   925	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUBS(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   926	        jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
   927	    } else {
   928	        return -1;
   929	    }
   930	    
   931	    /* Increment PC */
   932	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2);
   933	    
   934	    (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
   935	    return 0;
   936	}
   937	
   938	int jit_translate_cmp(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
   939	{
   940	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
   941	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
   942	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
   943	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
   944	    /* CMP decode:
   945	     * opmode bits 8..6:
   946	     *   000 CMP.B <ea>,Dn
   947	     *   001 CMP.W <ea>,Dn
   948	     *   010 CMP.L <ea>,Dn
   949	     *   011 CMPA.W / 111 CMPA.L (not handled here)
   950	     */
   951	    uint8_t opmode = (opcode >> 6) & 0x7;
   952	    uint8_t dst_reg = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
   953	    uint8_t src_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
   954	    uint8_t src_reg = opcode & 0x7;
   955	    int incr;
   956	
   957	    if (opmode > 2) {
   958	        return -1;
   959	    }
   960	
   961	    /* CMP <ea>,Dn */
   962	    jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
   963	
   964	    if (src_mode == 0) {
   965	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, src_reg);
   966	    } else if (src_mode == 2) {
   967	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   968	        if (opmode == 0) {
   969	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   970	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   971	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   972	        } else {
   973	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   974	        }
   975	    } else if (src_mode == 3) {
   976	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   977	        if (opmode == 0) {
   978	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   979	            incr = (src_reg == 7) ? 2 : 1;
   980	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   981	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   982	            incr = 2;
   983	        } else {
   984	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   985	            incr = 4;
   986	        }
   987	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   988	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)incr);
   989	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   990	        jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   991	    } else if (src_mode == 5) {
   992	        int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
   993	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, src_reg);
   994	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)(int32_t)disp);
   995	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
   996	        if (opmode == 0) {
   997	            jit_emit_call_read8(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
   998	        } else if (opmode == 1) {
   999	            jit_emit_call_read16(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
  1000	        } else {
  1001	            jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2);
  1002	        }
  1003	    } else {
  1004	        return -1;
  1005	    }
  1006	
  1007	    /* Width-normalize to top bits so SUBS carries byte/word flag semantics. */
  1008	    if (opmode == 0) {
  1009	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
  1010	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, 24));
  1011	    } else if (opmode == 1) {
  1012	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 16));
  1013	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, 16));
  1014	    }
  1015	
  1016	    /* CMP updates flags only. 68k subtract carry is inverse of AArch64 C. */
  1017	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUBS(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1018	    jit_emit_store_nzcv_flags(ctx, 1);
  1019	
  1020	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2 + ext_count * 2);
  1021	    return 0;
  1022	}
  1023	
  1024	int jit_translate_logic(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1025	{
  1026	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1027	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1028	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1029	    /* AND/OR/EOR: 1100/1000/1100 size(2) dst_mode(3) dst_reg(3) src_mode(3) src_reg(3) */
  1030	    uint8_t op = (opcode >> 13) & 0x7; /* 0=AND, 1=OR, 2=EOR */
  1031	    uint8_t dst_mode = (opcode >> 6) & 0x7;
  1032	    uint8_t dst_reg = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
  1033	    uint8_t src_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
  1034	    uint8_t src_reg = opcode & 0x7;
  1035	    
  1036	    /* Only implement Dn, Dn for now */
  1037	    if (dst_mode != 0 || src_mode != 0) {
  1038	        return -1; /* Fallback for other modes */
  1039	    }
  1040	    
  1041	    /* Load source and dest */
  1042	    jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, src_reg);
  1043	    jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R1, dst_reg);
  1044	    
  1045	    /* Perform operation */
  1046	    if (op == 0) {
  1047	        /* AND */
  1048	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1049	    } else if (op == 1) {
  1050	        /* OR */
  1051	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1052	    } else {
  1053	        /* EOR */
  1054	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1055	    }
  1056	    
  1057	    /* Store result */
  1058	    jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dst_reg);
  1059	    
  1060	    /* TODO: Update CCR flags (N, Z, V=0, C=0) */
  1061	    
  1062	    /* Increment PC */
  1063	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2);
  1064	    
  1065	    (void)ext_count;
  1066	    return 0;
  1067	}
  1068	
  1069	int jit_translate_branch(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1070	{
  1071	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1072	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1073	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1074	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1075	    /* BCC/BRA: 0110 cond(4) displacement */
  1076	    uint8_t cond = (opcode >> 8) & 0x0F;
  1077	    int32_t disp;
  1078	    int instr_size;
  1079	    
  1080	    /* Get displacement - byte or word */
  1081	    if ((opcode & 0xFF) == 0) {
  1082	        /* Word displacement */
  1083	        disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
  1084	        instr_size = 4;
  1085	    } else {
  1086	        /* Byte displacement */
  1087	        disp = (int8_t)(opcode & 0xFF);
  1088	        instr_size = 2;
  1089	    }
  1090	    
  1091	    /* CCR flag offsets in m68ki_cpu */
  1092	    /* n_flag=348, not_z_flag=352, v_flag=356, c_flag=360 */
  1093	    
  1094	    if (cond == 0) {
  1095	        /* BRA - unconditional branch */
  1096	        /* Load current PC */
  1097	        jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1098	        /* Add displacement only; common fall-through increment below adds instr_size. */
  1099	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1100	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1101	        /* Store new PC */
  1102	        jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1103	    } else {
  1104	        /* Conditional branches - check CCR flags */
  1105	        /* Load flags */
  1106	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 348)); /* n_flag */
  1107	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 352)); /* not_z_flag */
  1108	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 356)); /* v_flag */
  1109	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 360)); /* c_flag */
  1110	        
  1111	        /* Convert to boolean (0 or 1) */
  1112	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 7)); /* n = n_flag >> 7 */
  1113	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1114	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R7)); /* z = !not_z_flag & 1 */
  1115	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, 7)); /* v = v_flag >> 7 */
  1116	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_R3, 8)); /* c = c_flag >> 8 */
  1117	        
  1118	        /* Evaluate condition */
  1119	        switch (cond) {
  1120	            case 0x1: /* BRA (already handled) */
  1121	                break;
  1122	            case 0x2: /* BHI: !C && !Z */
  1123	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_R1));
  1124	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R4, 4)); /* if (!C && !Z) branch */
  1125	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_B(4)); /* else skip */
  1126	                /* Branch taken: update PC */
  1127	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1128	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1129	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1130	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1131	                break;
  1132	            case 0x3: /* BLS: C || Z */
  1133	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_R1));
  1134	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R4, 4));
  1135	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_B(4));
  1136	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1137	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1138	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1139	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1140	                break;
  1141	            case 0x4: /* BCC/BHS: !C */
  1142	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R3, 16));
  1143	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1144	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1145	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1146	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1147	                break;
  1148	            case 0x5: /* BCS/BLO: C */
  1149	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R3, 16));
  1150	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1151	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1152	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1153	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1154	                break;
  1155	            case 0x6: /* BNE: !Z */
  1156	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R1, 16));
  1157	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1158	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1159	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1160	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1161	                break;
  1162	            case 0x7: /* BEQ: Z */
  1163	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R1, 16));
  1164	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1165	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1166	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1167	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1168	                break;
  1169	            case 0x8: /* BVC: !V */
  1170	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R2, 16));
  1171	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1172	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1173	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1174	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1175	                break;
  1176	            case 0x9: /* BVS: V */
  1177	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R2, 16));
  1178	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1179	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1180	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1181	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1182	                break;
  1183	            case 0xA: /* BPL: !N */
  1184	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R0, 16));
  1185	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1186	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1187	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1188	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1189	                break;
  1190	            case 0xB: /* BMI: N */
  1191	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R0, 16));
  1192	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1193	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1194	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1195	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1196	                break;
  1197	            case 0xC: /* BGE: N == V */
  1198	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
  1199	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1200	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
  1201	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R4, 16));
  1202	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1203	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1204	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1205	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1206	                break;
  1207	            case 0xD: /* BLT: N != V */
  1208	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
  1209	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1210	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
  1211	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R4, 16));
  1212	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1213	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1214	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1215	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1216	                break;
  1217	            case 0xE: /* BGT: !Z && (N == V) */
  1218	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
  1219	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1220	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
  1221	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R1));
  1222	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R4, 16));
  1223	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1224	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1225	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1226	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1227	                break;
  1228	            case 0xF: /* BLE: Z || (N != V) */
  1229	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
  1230	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1231	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
  1232	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R1));
  1233	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R4, 16));
  1234	                jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1235	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, disp);
  1236	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1237	                jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1238	                break;
  1239	        }
  1240	    }
  1241	    
  1242	    /* Increment PC for fall-through (branch not taken) */
  1243	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, instr_size);
  1244	    
  1245	    (void)ext_count;
  1246	    return 0;
  1247	}
  1248	
  1249	int jit_translate_bsr(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1250	{
  1251	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1252	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1253	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1254	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1255	    /* BSR: Branch to subroutine - push return address, then branch */
  1256	    int32_t disp;
  1257	    int instr_size;
  1258	    
  1259	    /* Get displacement */
  1260	    if ((opcode & 0xFF) == 0) {
  1261	        disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
  1262	        instr_size = 4;
  1263	    } else {
  1264	        disp = (int8_t)(opcode & 0xFF);
  1265	        instr_size = 2;
  1266	    }
  1267	    
  1268	    /* Load A7 (SP) */
  1269	    jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1270	    
  1271	    /* Decrement SP by 4 */
  1272	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, 4);
  1273	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUB(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1274	    
  1275	    /* Load current PC + instr_size (return address) */
  1276	    jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R1);
  1277	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, instr_size);
  1278	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R2));
  1279	    
  1280	    /* Store updated SP before memory helper call (call clobbers caller-saved regs). */
  1281	    jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1282	
  1283	    /* Push return address to stack */
  1284	    jit_emit_call_write32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
  1285	    
  1286	    /* Calculate target PC = current PC + instr_size + disp */
  1287	    jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1288	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, instr_size + disp);
  1289	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1290	    jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1291	    
  1292	    (void)ext_count;
  1293	    return 0;
  1294	}
  1295	
  1296	int jit_translate_rts(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1297	{
  1298	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1299	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1300	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1301	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1302	    /* RTS: Return from subroutine - pop PC from stack */
  1303	    /* Load A7 (SP) */
  1304	    jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1305	    
  1306	    /* Load PC from stack */
  1307	    jit_emit_call_read32(ctx, AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0);
  1308	    
  1309	    /* Store to PC */
  1310	    jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R1);
  1311	    
  1312	    /* Increment SP by 4 */
  1313	    jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1314	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, 4);
  1315	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R2));
  1316	    jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1317	    
  1318	    (void)opcode; (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
  1319	    return 0;
  1320	}
  1321	
  1322	static void jit_movec_load_gpr(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t reg_field, uint8_t dst)
  1323	{
  1324	    if (reg_field < 8) {
  1325	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, dst, reg_field);
  1326	    } else {
  1327	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, dst, reg_field & 7);
  1328	    }
  1329	}
  1330	
  1331	static void jit_movec_store_gpr(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t reg_field, uint8_t src)
  1332	{
  1333	    if (reg_field < 8) {
  1334	        jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, src, reg_field);
  1335	    } else {
  1336	        jit_emit_store_an(ctx, src, reg_field & 7);
  1337	    }
  1338	}
  1339	
  1340	static uint32_t jit_translate_current_pc(const jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1341	{
  1342	    uint32_t pc = tctx->block->start_pc;
  1343	    uint16_t i;
  1344	    for (i = 0; i < tctx->instruction_index; i++) {
  1345	        pc += 2 + (uint32_t)(tctx->block->instructions[i].ext_count * 2);
  1346	    }
  1347	    return pc;
  1348	}
  1349	
  1350	int jit_translate_jsr(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1351	{
  1352	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1353	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1354	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1355	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1356	    uint8_t ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
  1357	    uint8_t ea_reg = opcode & 0x7;
  1358	    uint32_t return_pc = jit_translate_current_pc(tctx) + 2 + (uint32_t)(ext_count * 2);
  1359	
  1360	    /* Compute effective address into R2. JSR/JMP target is EA itself, not [EA]. */
  1361	    if (ea_mode == 2) {
  1362	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, ea_reg); /* (An) */
  1363	    } else if (ea_mode == 5 && ext_count >= 1) {
  1364	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, ea_reg); /* (d16,An) */
  1365	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]);
  1366	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
  1367	    } else if (ea_mode == 7 && ea_reg == 0 && ext_count >= 1) {
  1368	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]); /* (xxx).W */
  1369	    } else if (ea_mode == 7 && ea_reg == 1 && ext_count >= 2) {
  1370	        uint32_t abs_l = ((uint32_t)ext_words[0] << 16) | ext_words[1]; /* (xxx).L */
  1371	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, abs_l);
  1372	    } else {
  1373	        return -1;
  1374	    }
  1375	
  1376	    /* Push return PC on supervisor stack (A7). */
  1377	    jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1378	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, 4);
  1379	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUB(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1380	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, return_pc);
  1381	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_STR_W(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0, 0));
  1382	    jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 7);
  1383	
  1384	    /* PC = EA (no dereference). */
  1385	    jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R2);
  1386	    return 0;
  1387	}
  1388	
  1389	int jit_translate_jmp(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1390	{
  1391	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1392	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1393	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1394	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1395	    uint8_t ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
  1396	    uint8_t ea_reg = opcode & 0x7;
  1397	
  1398	    /* Compute effective address into R2. JMP target is EA itself, not [EA]. */
  1399	    if (ea_mode == 2) {
  1400	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, ea_reg); /* (An) */
  1401	    } else if (ea_mode == 5 && ext_count >= 1) {
  1402	        jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R2, ea_reg); /* (d16,An) */
  1403	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R3, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]);
  1404	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R3));
  1405	    } else if (ea_mode == 7 && ea_reg == 0 && ext_count >= 1) {
  1406	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]); /* (xxx).W */
  1407	    } else if (ea_mode == 7 && ea_reg == 1 && ext_count >= 2) {
  1408	        uint32_t abs_l = ((uint32_t)ext_words[0] << 16) | ext_words[1]; /* (xxx).L */
  1409	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R2, abs_l);
  1410	    } else {
  1411	        return -1;
  1412	    }
  1413	
  1414	    /* PC = EA (no dereference). */
  1415	    jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R2);
  1416	    return 0;
  1417	}
  1418	
  1419	int jit_translate_movec(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1420	{
  1421	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1422	    m68ki_cpu_core *cpu = tctx->jit ? tctx->jit->cpu : NULL;
  1423	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1424	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1425	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1426	    uint16_t ext;
  1427	    uint8_t reg_field;
  1428	    uint16_t creg;
  1429	    int rn_to_cr;
  1430	    int handled = 1;
  1431	    const int off_sp = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, sp);
  1432	    const int off_sp_elem = (int)sizeof(((struct m68ki_cpu_core *)0)->sp[0]);
  1433	    const int off_vbr = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, vbr);
  1434	    const int off_sfc = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, sfc);
  1435	    const int off_dfc = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, dfc);
  1436	    const int off_cacr = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, cacr);
  1437	    const int off_mmu_mmusr = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, mmu_sr_040);
  1438	    const int off_mmu_urp = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, mmu_urp_aptr);
  1439	    const int off_mmu_srp = (int)offsetof(struct m68ki_cpu_core, mmu_srp_aptr);
  1440	
  1441	    if (!cpu || ext_count < 1) {
  1442	        return -1;
  1443	    }
  1444	
  1445	    /* MOVEC is privileged; force fallback outside supervisor mode. */
  1446	    if (!cpu->s_flag) {
  1447	        return -1;
  1448	    }
  1449	
  1450	    ext = ext_words[0];
  1451	
  1452	    /* 68040 cache/MMU ops sharing MOVEC space (PFLUSH/CPUSH class). */
  1453	    if ((ext & 0xF000) == 0xF000) {
  1454	        jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 4);
  1455	        return 0;
  1456	    }
  1457	
  1458	    /* MOVEC decode (matches Musashi): reg field in bits 15..12, control reg in bits 11..0. */
  1459	    reg_field = (uint8_t)((ext >> 12) & 0x0F); /* 0..7 Dn, 8..15 An */
  1460	    creg = ext & 0x0FFF;
  1461	    rn_to_cr = (opcode & 1) ? 1 : 0;          /* 4E7B: Rn->CR, 4E7A: CR->Rn */
  1462	
  1463	    if (!rn_to_cr) {
  1464	        /* MOVEC CR,Rn */
  1465	        switch (creg) {
  1466	        case 0x000: /* SFC */
  1467	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sfc);
  1468	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1469	            break;
  1470	        case 0x001: /* DFC */
  1471	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_dfc);
  1472	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1473	            break;
  1474	        case 0x800: /* USP */
  1475	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (0 * off_sp_elem));
  1476	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1477	            break;
  1478	        case 0x801: /* VBR */
  1479	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_vbr);
  1480	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1481	            break;
  1482	        case 0x803: /* MSP */
  1483	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (6 * off_sp_elem));
  1484	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1485	            break;
  1486	        case 0x804: /* ISP */
  1487	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (4 * off_sp_elem));
  1488	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1489	            break;
  1490	        case 0x002: /* CACR */
  1491	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_cacr);
  1492	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1493	            break;
  1494	        case 0x808: /* PCR */
  1495	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, 0x04310000u);
  1496	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1497	            break;
  1498	        case 0x003: /* TC */
  1499	            jit_emit_load_tc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1500	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1501	            break;
  1502	        case 0x004: /* ITT0 */
  1503	            jit_emit_load_itt0(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1504	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1505	            break;
  1506	        case 0x005: /* ITT1 */
  1507	            jit_emit_load_itt1(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1508	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1509	            break;
  1510	        case 0x006: /* DTT0 */
  1511	            jit_emit_load_dtt0(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1512	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1513	            break;
  1514	        case 0x007: /* DTT1 */
  1515	            jit_emit_load_dtt1(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1516	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1517	            break;
  1518	        case 0x805: /* MMUSR */
  1519	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_mmusr);
  1520	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1521	            break;
  1522	        case 0x806: /* URP */
  1523	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_urp);
  1524	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1525	            break;
  1526	        case 0x807: /* SRP */
  1527	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_srp);
  1528	            jit_movec_store_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1529	            break;
  1530	        default:
  1531	            handled = 0;
  1532	            break;
  1533	        }
  1534	    } else {
  1535	        /* MOVEC Rn,CR */
  1536	        jit_movec_load_gpr(ctx, reg_field, AARCH64_R0);
  1537	        switch (creg) {
  1538	        case 0x000: /* SFC */
  1539	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sfc);
  1540	            break;
  1541	        case 0x001: /* DFC */
  1542	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_dfc);
  1543	            break;
  1544	        case 0x800: /* USP */
  1545	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (0 * off_sp_elem));
  1546	            break;
  1547	        case 0x801: /* VBR */
  1548	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_vbr);
  1549	            break;
  1550	        case 0x803: /* MSP */
  1551	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (6 * off_sp_elem));
  1552	            break;
  1553	        case 0x804: /* ISP */
  1554	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_sp + (4 * off_sp_elem));
  1555	            break;
  1556	        case 0x002: /* CACR */
  1557	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_cacr);
  1558	            break;
  1559	        case 0x003: /* TC */
  1560	            jit_emit_store_tc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1561	            break;
  1562	        case 0x004: /* ITT0 */
  1563	            jit_emit_store_itt0(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1564	            break;
  1565	        case 0x005: /* ITT1 */
  1566	            jit_emit_store_itt1(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1567	            break;
  1568	        case 0x006: /* DTT0 */
  1569	            jit_emit_store_dtt0(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1570	            break;
  1571	        case 0x007: /* DTT1 */
  1572	            jit_emit_store_dtt1(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1573	            break;
  1574	        case 0x805: /* MMUSR */
  1575	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_mmusr);
  1576	            break;
  1577	        case 0x806: /* URP */
  1578	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_urp);
  1579	            break;
  1580	        case 0x807: /* SRP */
  1581	            jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R0, off_mmu_srp);
  1582	            break;
  1583	        default:
  1584	            handled = 0;
  1585	            break;
  1586	        }
  1587	    }
  1588	
  1589	    if (!handled) {
  1590	        return -1;
  1591	    }
  1592	
  1593	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 4);
  1594	    return 0;
  1595	}
  1596	
  1597	int jit_translate_extb(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1598	{
  1599	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1600	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1601	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1602	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1603	    /* EXTB: Sign Extend Byte to Long (68020+)
  1604	     * Format: 0100100011000nnn (0x49C0-0x49C7)
  1605	     * Extends bit 7 of Dn to fill all 32 bits
  1606	     */
  1607	    (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
  1608	    
  1609	    uint8_t dn = opcode & 7;
  1610	    
  1611	    /* Load Dn, sign extend byte to 32 bits */
  1612	    jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dn);
  1613	    /* LSL #24, then ASR #24 to sign-extend byte */
  1614	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
  1615	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ASR(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, 24));
  1616	    jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dn);
  1617	    
  1618	    /* Set N and Z flags, clear V and C */
  1619	    /* TODO: implement CCR update */
  1620	    
  1621	    /* Increment PC */
  1622	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2);
  1623	    
  1624	    return 0;
  1625	}
  1626	
  1627	int jit_translate_lea(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1628	{
  1629	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1630	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1631	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1632	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1633	    /* LEA: Load Effective Address
  1634	     * Format: 0100 1111 MM MMM RRR (for xxx.L,An)
  1635	     *       or 0100 dd01 MM MMM RRR (for d16(An),An) etc.
  1636	     * Bits 11-6 = EA mode, Bits 5-3 = An (dest), Bits 2-0 = unused
  1637	     * 
  1638	     * EA modes supported:
  1639	     * - d16(An): 010 (ext_words[0] = displacement)
  1640	     * - d16(PC): 111 010 (ext_words[0] = displacement)
  1641	     * - xxx.W: 111 110 (ext_words[0] = absolute address)
  1642	     * - xxx.L: 111 111 (ext_words[0] = high word, ext_words[1] = low word)
  1643	     */
  1644	    (void)ext_count;
  1645	    
  1646	    uint8_t ea_mode = (opcode >> 3) & 0x7;
  1647	    uint8_t ea_reg = opcode & 0x7;
  1648	    uint8_t an_dest = (opcode >> 9) & 0x7;
  1649	    
  1650	    /* Calculate effective address based on EA mode */
  1651	    switch (ea_mode) {
  1652	        case 2: /* (An) - Address register indirect */
  1653	            /* LEA (An),An - just copy address register */
  1654	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
  1655	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, an_dest);
  1656	            break;
  1657	            
  1658	        case 5: /* d16(An) - Address register indirect with displacement */
  1659	            /* LEA d16(An),An - An + sign-extended displacement */
  1660	            jit_emit_load_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ea_reg);
  1661	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]);
  1662	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1663	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, an_dest);
  1664	            break;
  1665	            
  1666	        case 6: /* d16(PC) - PC relative with displacement */
  1667	            /* LEA d16(PC),An - PC + sign-extended displacement */
  1668	            /* Note: PC here is the PC after the instruction */
  1669	            jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]);
  1670	            /* We need the actual PC value - this requires runtime PC */
  1671	            /* For now, emit a load from m68ki_cpu.pc + displacement */
  1672	            jit_emit_load_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R1, 128);  /* Load PC */
  1673	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1674	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, an_dest);
  1675	            break;
  1676	            
  1677	        case 7: /* Absolute - check ea_reg for .W vs .L */
  1678	            if (ea_reg == 0) {
  1679	                /* xxx.W - absolute word (sign extended) */
  1680	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, (uint64_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ext_words[0]);
  1681	            } else if (ea_reg == 1) {
  1682	                /* xxx.L - absolute long */
  1683	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R0, ((uint64_t)ext_words[0] << 16) | ext_words[1]);
  1684	            }
  1685	            jit_emit_store_an(ctx, AARCH64_R0, an_dest);
  1686	            break;
  1687
