  1688	        default:
  1689	            /* Unsupported EA mode - fall back */
  1690	            return -1;
  1691	    }
  1692	    
  1693	    /* Increment PC */
  1694	    jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 2 + ext_count * 2);
  1695	    
  1696	    return 0;
  1697	}
  1698	
  1699	int jit_translate_misc(jit_translate_context_t *tctx)
  1700	{
  1701	    jit_emit_context_t *ctx = tctx->emit;
  1702	    uint16_t opcode = tctx->opcode;
  1703	    uint16_t *ext_words = tctx->ext_words;
  1704	    int ext_count = tctx->ext_count;
  1705	    /* DBcc: 0101 cond(4) 11001 Dn (4 bytes total) */
  1706	    if ((opcode & 0xF0F8) == 0x50C8) {
  1707	        uint8_t cond = (opcode >> 8) & 0x0F;
  1708	        uint8_t dn = opcode & 0x7;
  1709	        int16_t disp = (int16_t)ext_words[0];
  1710	        
  1711	        /* Load Dn counter */
  1712	        jit_emit_load_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dn);
  1713	        
  1714	        /* Decrement counter */
  1715	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, 1);
  1716	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_SUB(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1717	        jit_emit_store_dn(ctx, AARCH64_R0, dn);
  1718	        
  1719	        /* Check if counter == -1 (0xFFFF) */
  1720	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 0xFFFF);
  1721	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R1, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R7));
  1722	        
  1723	        /* Load CCR flags for condition check */
  1724	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 348)); /* n_flag */
  1725	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 352)); /* not_z_flag */
  1726	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 356)); /* v_flag */
  1727	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R5, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, 360)); /* c_flag */
  1728	        
  1729	        /* Convert to boolean */
  1730	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R2, 7)); /* n */
  1731	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1732	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_R3, AARCH64_R7)); /* z */
  1733	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, 7)); /* v */
  1734	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R5, AARCH64_R5, 8)); /* c */
  1735	        
  1736	        /* Evaluate condition - if TRUE, don't branch (counter not -1) */
  1737	        switch (cond) {
  1738	            case 0x0: /* DBRA/DBT: always branch if counter != -1 */
  1739	                break; /* Always true, just check counter */
  1740	            case 0x1: /* DBF/DBRA: always false, just check counter */
  1741	                break;
  1742	            case 0x2: /* DBHI: !C && !Z */
  1743	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R5, AARCH64_R3));
  1744	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R6, 8)); /* if C || Z, skip branch */
  1745	                break;
  1746	            case 0x3: /* DBLS: C || Z */
  1747	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R5, AARCH64_R3));
  1748	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R6, 8)); /* if !C && !Z, skip branch */
  1749	                break;
  1750	            case 0x4: /* DBCC: !C */
  1751	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R5, 8));
  1752	                break;
  1753	            case 0x5: /* DBCS: C */
  1754	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R5, 8));
  1755	                break;
  1756	            case 0x6: /* DBNE: !Z */
  1757	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R3, 8));
  1758	                break;
  1759	            case 0x7: /* DBEQ: Z */
  1760	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R3, 8));
  1761	                break;
  1762	            case 0x8: /* DBVC: !V */
  1763	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R4, 8));
  1764	                break;
  1765	            case 0x9: /* DBVS: V */
  1766	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R4, 8));
  1767	                break;
  1768	            case 0xA: /* DBPL: !N */
  1769	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R2, 8));
  1770	                break;
  1771	            case 0xB: /* DBMI: N */
  1772	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R2, 8));
  1773	                break;
  1774	            case 0xC: /* DBGE: N == V */
  1775	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R4));
  1776	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1777	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R7));
  1778	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R6, 8));
  1779	                break;
  1780	            case 0xD: /* DBLT: N != V */
  1781	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R4));
  1782	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1783	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R7));
  1784	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R6, 8));
  1785	                break;
  1786	            case 0xE: /* DBGT: !Z && (N == V) */
  1787	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R4));
  1788	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1789	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R7));
  1790	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R3));
  1791	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R6, 8));
  1792	                break;
  1793	            case 0xF: /* DBLE: Z || (N != V) */
  1794	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R2, AARCH64_R4));
  1795	                jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
  1796	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R7));
  1797	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR_W(AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R6, AARCH64_R3));
  1798	                jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBZ(AARCH64_R6, 8));
  1799	                break;
  1800	        }
  1801	        
  1802	        /* Branch if counter != -1 */
  1803	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_CBNZ(AARCH64_R1, 8)); /* if counter != -1, skip branch */
  1804	        
  1805	        /* Branch taken: update PC */
  1806	        jit_emit_load_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1807	        jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, 4 + disp);
  1808	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
  1809	        jit_emit_store_pc(ctx, AARCH64_R0);
  1810	        
  1811	        /* Increment PC for fall-through */
  1812	        jit_emit_inc_pc(ctx, 4);
  1813	        
  1814	        return 0;
  1815	    }
  1816	    
  1817	    /* CLR, TST, bit ops - fallback to Musashi */
  1818	    (void)ctx; (void)opcode; (void)ext_words; (void)ext_count;
  1819	    return -1;
  1820	}


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_block.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Block Header
     3	 * 
     4	 * Manages compiled basic blocks.
     5	 */
     6	
     7	#ifndef JIT_BLOCK_H
     8	#define JIT_BLOCK_H
     9	
    10	#include <stdint.h>
    11	#include <stdbool.h>
    12	#include <stddef.h>
    13	#include "jit.h"
    14	
    15	/* Maximum instructions per block */
    16	#define JIT_MAX_BLOCK_INSTRUCTIONS  64
    17	
    18	/* Block flags */
    19	#define JIT_BLOCK_VALID         0x01    /* Block is valid and executable */
    20	#define JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_BRANCH   0x02    /* Block ends with a branch */
    21	#define JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_TRAP     0x04    /* Block ends with a trap/exception */
    22	#define JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_RTS      0x08    /* Block ends with RTS */
    23	#define JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_RTE      0x10    /* Block ends with RTE */
    24	#define JIT_BLOCK_ENDS_JMP      0x20    /* Block ends with JMP/JSR */
    25	#define JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY 0x40   /* Cached as interpreter-only (no native code) */
    26	
    27	/* Compiled block structure */
    28	struct jit_block {
    29	    /* Lookup key */
    30	    uint32_t start_pc;              /* Starting PC of this block */
    31	    uint32_t end_pc;                /* Ending PC (after last instruction) */
    32	    
    33	    /* Code cache location */
    34	    uint8_t *code_ptr;              /* Pointer to compiled code in cache */
    35	    size_t code_size;               /* Size of compiled code in bytes */
    36	    
    37	    /* Block metadata */
    38	    uint16_t instruction_count;     /* Number of instructions in block */
    39	    uint16_t flags;                 /* Block flags */
    40	    uint8_t ends_block;             /* Block ends with control flow change */
    41	    uint8_t cycle_count;            /* Base cycle count for the block */
    42	    
    43	    /* Hash table linkage */
    44	    jit_block_t *hash_next;         /* Next block in hash chain */
    45	    
    46	    /* Instruction info for debugging */
    47	    struct {
    48	        uint16_t opcode;
    49	        uint16_t ext_words[4];
    50	        uint8_t ext_count;
    51	        uint8_t cycles;
    52	    } instructions[JIT_MAX_BLOCK_INSTRUCTIONS];
    53	
    54	    /* Host code byte offsets per translated 68k instruction start.
    55	     * host_offsets[i] is start offset of instructions[i], and
    56	     * host_offsets[instruction_count] is end of translated instruction region. */
    57	    uint16_t host_offsets[JIT_MAX_BLOCK_INSTRUCTIONS + 1];
    58	};
    59	
    60	/* Block allocation */
    61	jit_block_t *jit_block_alloc(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc);
    62	void jit_block_free(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block);
    63	
    64	/* Block translation */
    65	int jit_block_translate(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block);
    66	
    67	/* Block emission */
    68	int jit_block_emit(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block);
    69	
    70	/* Block execution */
    71	int jit_block_execute(jit_block_t *block, int max_cycles);
    72	
    73	/* Block invalidation */
    74	void jit_block_invalidate(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block);
    75	
    76	/* Block debugging */
    77	void jit_block_dump(jit_block_t *block);
    78	
    79	#endif /* JIT_BLOCK_H */

    28	static void jit_dump_current_block_fault(uint64_t fault_pc)
    29	{
    30	    jit_block_t *block = g_jit.current_block;
    31	    uintptr_t base;
    32	    uintptr_t end;
    33	    size_t byte_off;
    34	    size_t word_idx;
    35	    int instr_idx = -1;
    36	
    37	    if (!block || !block->code_ptr || block->code_size == 0) {
    38	        fprintf(stderr, "Current JIT block: unavailable\n");
    39	        return;
    40	    }
    41	
    42	    base = (uintptr_t)block->code_ptr;
    43	    end = base + block->code_size;
    44	    fprintf(stderr, "Current JIT block: entry=0x%08X host=%p size=%zu\n",
    45	            block->start_pc, (void *)block->code_ptr, block->code_size);
    46	
    47	    if ((uintptr_t)fault_pc < base || (uintptr_t)fault_pc >= end) {
    48	        fprintf(stderr, "Fault PC is outside current JIT block range.\n");
    49	        return;
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    byte_off = (size_t)((uintptr_t)fault_pc - base);
    53	    word_idx = byte_off / 4u;
    54	    fprintf(stderr, "Fault offset in block: +0x%zX (word[%zu])\n", byte_off, word_idx);
    55	    fprintf(stderr, "Fault word: 0x%08X\n", ((uint32_t *)block->code_ptr)[word_idx]);
    56	
    57	    for (int i = 0; i < block->instruction_count; i++) {
    58	        uint32_t start = block->host_offsets[i];
    59	        uint32_t stop = block->host_offsets[i + 1];
    60	        if (byte_off >= start && byte_off < stop) {
    61	            instr_idx = i;
    62	            break;
    63	        }
    64	    }
    65	
    66	    if (instr_idx >= 0) {
    67	        fprintf(stderr, "Mapped 68k instruction index: %d opcode=0x%04X ext_count=%u\n",
    68	                instr_idx,
    69	                block->instructions[instr_idx].opcode,
    70	                (unsigned)block->instructions[instr_idx].ext_count);
    71	    } else {
    72	        fprintf(stderr, "Mapped 68k instruction index: none (likely epilogue/return path)\n");
    73	    }
    74	}
    75	
    76	/* Signal handler for illegal instruction (SIGILL) */
    77	static void jit_sigill_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *info, void *context)
    78	{
    79	    ucontext_t *uc = (ucontext_t *)context;
    80	    uint64_t fault_pc = uc->uc_mcontext.pc;
    81	    
    82	    fprintf(stderr, "\n\n!!! SIGILL - Illegal Instruction !!!\n");
    83	    fprintf(stderr, "Fault PC: 0x%016lX (AArch64)\n", fault_pc);
    84	    fprintf(stderr, "JIT enabled: %d\n", g_jit.enabled);
    85	    fprintf(stderr, "Safe interp: %d\n", g_jit_safe_interp_enabled);
    86	    fprintf(stderr, "Current 68k PC: 0x%08X\n", g_jit.current_pc);
    87	    jit_dump_current_block_fault(fault_pc);
    88	    
    89	    if (g_jit.cpu) {
    90	        fprintf(stderr, "\n68k CPU State:\n");
    91	        fprintf(stderr, "D0-D7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
    92	                g_jit.cpu->dar[0], g_jit.cpu->dar[1], g_jit.cpu->dar[2], g_jit.cpu->dar[3],
    93	                g_jit.cpu->dar[4], g_jit.cpu->dar[5], g_jit.cpu->dar[6], g_jit.cpu->dar[7]);
    94	        fprintf(stderr, "A0-A7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
    95	                g_jit.cpu->dar[8], g_jit.cpu->dar[9], g_jit.cpu->dar[10], g_jit.cpu->dar[11],
    96	                g_jit.cpu->dar[12], g_jit.cpu->dar[13], g_jit.cpu->dar[14], g_jit.cpu->dar[15]);
    97	        fprintf(stderr, "PC: %08X\n", g_jit.cpu->pc);
    98	    }
    99	    
   100	    fprintf(stderr, "\nThis is a JIT code generation/runtime bug.\n");
   101	    
   102	    (void)sig;
   103	    (void)info;
   104	    
   105	    _exit(1);
   106	}
   107	
   108	static void jit_sigsegv_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *info, void *context)
   109	{
   110	    ucontext_t *uc = (ucontext_t *)context;
   111	    uint64_t fault_pc = uc->uc_mcontext.pc;
   112	
   113	    fprintf(stderr, "\n\n!!! SIGSEGV - Segmentation Fault in JIT path !!!\n");
   114	    fprintf(stderr, "Fault PC: 0x%016lX (AArch64)\n", fault_pc);
   115	    fprintf(stderr, "Fault address: %p\n", info ? info->si_addr : NULL);
   116	    fprintf(stderr, "JIT enabled: %d\n", g_jit.enabled);
   117	    fprintf(stderr, "Safe interp: %d\n", g_jit_safe_interp_enabled);
   118	    fprintf(stderr, "Current 68k PC: 0x%08X\n", g_jit.current_pc);
   119	    jit_dump_current_block_fault(fault_pc);
   120	
   121	    if (g_jit.cpu) {
   122	        fprintf(stderr, "\n68k CPU State:\n");
   123	        fprintf(stderr, "D0-D7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
   124	                g_jit.cpu->dar[0], g_jit.cpu->dar[1], g_jit.cpu->dar[2], g_jit.cpu->dar[3],
   125	                g_jit.cpu->dar[4], g_jit.cpu->dar[5], g_jit.cpu->dar[6], g_jit.cpu->dar[7]);
   126	        fprintf(stderr, "A0-A7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
   127	                g_jit.cpu->dar[8], g_jit.cpu->dar[9], g_jit.cpu->dar[10], g_jit.cpu->dar[11],
   128	                g_jit.cpu->dar[12], g_jit.cpu->dar[13], g_jit.cpu->dar[14], g_jit.cpu->dar[15]);
   129	        fprintf(stderr, "PC: %08X\n", g_jit.cpu->pc);
   130	    }
   131	
   132	    (void)sig;
   133	    _exit(1);
   134	}

   136	static void jit_install_signal_handler(void)
   137	{
   138	    struct sigaction sa;
   139	    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
   140	    sa.sa_sigaction = jit_sigill_handler;
   141	    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
   142	    sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
   143	
   144	    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
   145	    sa.sa_sigaction = jit_sigsegv_handler;
   146	    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
   147	    sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
   148	}

   153	        const char *e = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_FASTSTEP");
   154	        /* Keep fast-step opt-in until semantics are fully validated. */
   155	        g_jit_faststep_enabled = (e && atoi(e) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
   156	        if (g_jit_faststep_enabled) {
   157	            LOG_INFO("[CPU] m68xkcpu fast-step enabled via PISTORM_M68XK_FASTSTEP=1\n");

   159	            if (e) {
   160	                LOG_WARN("[CPU] m68xkcpu fast-step disabled via PISTORM_M68XK_FASTSTEP=0\n");
   161	            } else {
   162	                LOG_INFO("[CPU] m68xkcpu fast-step disabled by default (set PISTORM_M68XK_FASTSTEP=1 to enable)\n");
   163	            }
   164	        }
   165	    }
   166	    return g_jit_faststep_enabled;
   167	}

   193	static void jit_trace_block_exec(const char *phase,
   194	                                 const char *origin,
   195	                                 uint32_t pc,
   196	                                 uint32_t new_pc,
   197	                                 int cycles,
   198	                                 const jit_block_t *block,
   199	                                 const char *note)
   200	{
   201	    uint16_t flags = block ? block->flags : 0u;
   202	    uint8_t ends_block = block ? block->ends_block : 0u;
   203	    uint16_t icount = block ? block->instruction_count : 0u;
   204	
   205	    if (!jit_trace_blocks_enabled()) {
   206	        return;
   207	    }
   208	    LOG_INFO("[CPU][m68xkcpu][BLOCK] phase=%s origin=%s entry=0x%08X exit=0x%08X "
   209	             "block_cycles=%d flags=0x%04X ends_block=%u icount=%u note=%s\n",
   210	             phase ? phase : "?",
   211	             origin ? origin : "?",
   212	             pc,
   213	             new_pc,
   214	             cycles,
   215	             (unsigned)flags,
   216	             (unsigned)ends_block,
   217	             (unsigned)icount,
   218	             note ? note : "-");
   219	}
   220	
   221	typedef struct {
   222	    uint32_t entries[8];
   223	    uint8_t count;
   224	    uint32_t last_entry;
   225	    uint32_t last_exit;
   226	    uint16_t same_entry_hits;
   227	    uint16_t pair_hits;
   228	} jit_progress_tracker_t;
   229	
   230	/* Persist loop tracking across jit_execute() slices. */
   231	static jit_progress_tracker_t g_jit_progress = {0};
   232	
   233	static void jit_progress_push_entry(jit_progress_tracker_t *tracker, uint32_t entry_pc)
   234	{
   235	    if (!tracker) {
   236	        return;
   237	    }
   238	    if (tracker->count < (uint8_t)(sizeof(tracker->entries) / sizeof(tracker->entries[0]))) {
   239	        tracker->entries[tracker->count++] = entry_pc;
   240	    } else {
   241	        memmove(&tracker->entries[0], &tracker->entries[1], sizeof(tracker->entries) - sizeof(tracker->entries[0]));
   242	        tracker->entries[(sizeof(tracker->entries) / sizeof(tracker->entries[0])) - 1u] = entry_pc;
   243	    }
   244	}
   245	
   246	static const char *jit_progress_update_and_detect(jit_progress_tracker_t *tracker,
   247	                                                  uint32_t entry_pc,
   248	                                                  uint32_t exit_pc)
   249	{
   250	    uint32_t min_pc;
   251	    uint32_t max_pc;
   252	
   253	    if (!tracker) {
   254	        return NULL;
   255	    }
   256	
   257	    if (tracker->last_entry == entry_pc) {
   258	        tracker->same_entry_hits++;
   259	    } else {
   260	        tracker->same_entry_hits = 1;
   261	    }
   262	
   263	    if (tracker->last_entry == entry_pc && tracker->last_exit == exit_pc) {
   264	        tracker->pair_hits++;
   265	    } else {
   266	        tracker->pair_hits = 1;
   267	    }
   268	
   269	    tracker->last_entry = entry_pc;
   270	    tracker->last_exit = exit_pc;
   271	    jit_progress_push_entry(tracker, entry_pc);
   272	
   273	    if (tracker->same_entry_hits >= 4u) {
   274	        return "same-entry-streak";
   275	    }
   276	    if (tracker->pair_hits >= 4u) {
   277	        return "entry-exit-repeat";
   278	    }
   279	
   280	    if (tracker->count >= 4u) {
   281	        uint8_t n = tracker->count;
   282	        uint32_t a = tracker->entries[n - 4u];
   283	        uint32_t b = tracker->entries[n - 3u];
   284	        uint32_t c = tracker->entries[n - 2u];
   285	        uint32_t d = tracker->entries[n - 1u];
   286	        if (a == c && b == d && a != b) {
   287	            return "entry-ping-pong";
   288	        }
   289	    }
   290	
   291	    if (tracker->count >= 4u) {
   292	        min_pc = tracker->entries[0];
   293	        max_pc = tracker->entries[0];
   294	        for (uint8_t i = 1u; i < tracker->count; i++) {
   295	            if (tracker->entries[i] < min_pc) {
   296	                min_pc = tracker->entries[i];
   297	            }
   298	            if (tracker->entries[i] > max_pc) {
   299	                max_pc = tracker->entries[i];
   300	            }
   301	        }
   302	        if ((max_pc - min_pc) <= 8u) {
   303	            return "tiny-entry-window";
   304	        }
   305	    }
   306	
   307	    return NULL;
   308	}
   309	
   310	int jit_no_fallback_enabled(void)
   311	{
   312	#if !USE_MUSASHI
   313	    if (g_jit_no_fallback_enabled < 0) {
   314	        g_jit_no_fallback_enabled = 1;
   315	        LOG_WARN("[CPU] m68xkcpu strict mode forced: USE_MUSASHI=0 disables Musashi fallback\n");
   316	    }
   317	    return 1;
   318	#else
   319	    if (g_jit_no_fallback_enabled < 0) {
   320	        const char *strict_env = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_NO_FALLBACK");
   321	        const char *allow_env = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_ALLOW_FALLBACK");
   322	        if (strict_env) {
   323	            g_jit_no_fallback_enabled = (atoi(strict_env) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
   324	        } else {
   325	            /* Default to strict JIT-only execution unless explicitly relaxed. */
   326	            g_jit_no_fallback_enabled = (allow_env && atoi(allow_env) != 0) ? 0 : 1;
   327	        }
   328	        if (g_jit_no_fallback_enabled) {
   329	            LOG_WARN("[CPU] m68xkcpu strict mode enabled - Musashi fallback disabled; unsupported paths will abort()\n");
   330	        } else {
   331	            LOG_WARN("[CPU] m68xkcpu fallback explicitly enabled via PISTORM_M68XK_ALLOW_FALLBACK=1\n");
   332	        }
   333	    }
   334	    return g_jit_no_fallback_enabled;
   335	#endif
   336	}
   337	
   338	void jit_hard_fail(uint32_t pc, uint16_t opcode, const char *reason)
   339	{
   340	    LOG_ERROR("[CPU] m68xkcpu HARD FAIL at PC=0x%08X: opcode=0x%04X reason=%s\n", pc, opcode, reason);
   341	    LOG_ERROR("[CPU] m68xkcpu: Aborting due to unsupported instruction with NO_FALLBACK=1\n");
   342	    
   343	    /* Dump CPU state for debugging */
   344	    extern struct m68ki_cpu_core m68ki_cpu;
   345	    LOG_ERROR("[CPU] D0-D7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
   346	              m68ki_cpu.dar[0], m68ki_cpu.dar[1], m68ki_cpu.dar[2], m68ki_cpu.dar[3],
   347	              m68ki_cpu.dar[4], m68ki_cpu.dar[5], m68ki_cpu.dar[6], m68ki_cpu.dar[7]);
   348	    LOG_ERROR("[CPU] A0-A7: %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X %08X\n",
   349	              m68ki_cpu.dar[8], m68ki_cpu.dar[9], m68ki_cpu.dar[10], m68ki_cpu.dar[11],
   350	              m68ki_cpu.dar[12], m68ki_cpu.dar[13], m68ki_cpu.dar[14], m68ki_cpu.dar[15]);
   351	    LOG_ERROR("[CPU] PC=%08X SR=%04X\n", m68ki_cpu.pc, 
   352	              (m68ki_cpu.s_flag << 13) | (m68ki_cpu.m_flag << 11) | (m68ki_cpu.int_mask << 8) |
   353	              ((m68ki_cpu.x_flag >> 4) << 4) | ((m68ki_cpu.n_flag >> 4) << 3) |
   354	              ((!m68ki_cpu.not_z_flag) << 2) | ((m68ki_cpu.v_flag >> 6) << 1) | (m68ki_cpu.c_flag >> 8));
   355	    
   356	    abort();
   357	}
   358	
   359	static int jit_fallback_interpreter_step(jit_context_t *jit, int cycles_budget)
   360	{
   361	    int ran;
   362	    int slice;
   363	    uint8_t fc_prog;
   364	    uint16_t opcode = 0;
   365	    if (!jit || !jit->cpu) {
   366	        return -1;
   367	    }
   368	
   369	    if (jit_no_fallback_enabled()) {
   370	        fc_prog = jit_get_fc(jit->cpu->s_flag ? 1 : 0, 1);
   371	        opcode = jit_fetch_word(jit->cpu->pc, fc_prog);
   372	        jit_hard_fail(jit->cpu->pc, opcode, "fallback-disabled");
   373	        return -1;
   374	    }
   375	
   376	    if (cycles_budget <= 0) {
   377	        return 0;
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    /* Keep fallback semantics aligned with the emulator's normal Musashi path. */
   381	    extern void musashi_backend_execute(m68ki_cpu_core *state, int cycles);
   382	    slice = (cycles_budget > 256) ? 256 : cycles_budget;
   383	    musashi_backend_execute(jit->cpu, slice);
   384	    ran = slice;
   385	    jit->current_pc = (uint32_t)m68k_get_reg(jit->cpu, M68K_REG_PC);
   386	    return ran;
   387	}
   388	
   389	static inline int jit_flag_c(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu) { return (cpu->c_flag & 0x100u) != 0; }
   390	static inline int jit_flag_v(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu) { return (cpu->v_flag & 0x80u) != 0; }
   391	static inline int jit_flag_n(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu) { return (cpu->n_flag & 0x80u) != 0; }
   392	static inline int jit_flag_z(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu) { return cpu->not_z_flag == 0; }
   393	
   394	static inline uint64_t jit_hash_u32(uint64_t acc, uint32_t v)
   395	{
   396	    /* Small, stable combiner for MMU-visible state fields. */
   397	    return (acc ^ (uint64_t)v) * 1099511628211ULL;
   398	}
   399	
   400	static uint64_t jit_mmu_state_signature(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu)
   401	{
   402	    uint64_t sig = 1469598103934665603ULL;
   403	    if (!cpu) {
   404	        return 0;
   405	    }
   406	
   407	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_tc);
   408	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_itt0);
   409	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_itt1);
   410	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_dtt0);
   411	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_dtt1);
   412	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_sr_040);
   413	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_urp_aptr);
   414	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->mmu_srp_aptr);
   415	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->sfc);
   416	    sig = jit_hash_u32(sig, cpu->dfc);
   417	    return sig;
   418	}
   419	
   420	static void jit_refresh_mmu_tracking(jit_context_t *jit)
   421	{
   422	    uint64_t sig_now;
   423	
   424	    if (!jit || !jit->cpu) {
   425	        return;
   426	    }
   427	
   428	    sig_now = jit_mmu_state_signature(jit->cpu);
   429	    if (!jit->mmu_state_valid) {
   430	        jit->mmu_state_sig = sig_now;
   431	        jit->mmu_state_valid = true;
   432	        return;
   433	    }
   434	
   435	    if (sig_now != jit->mmu_state_sig) {
   436	        LOG_INFO("[CPU][m68xkcpu][MMU] state change detected; invalidating JIT cache\n");
   437	        jit_invalidate_all();
   438	        jit->mmu_state_sig = sig_now;
   439	    }
   440	}
   441	
   442	static int jit_eval_cond(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, uint8_t cond)
   443	{
   444	    int c = jit_flag_c(cpu);
   445	    int v = jit_flag_v(cpu);
   446	    int n = jit_flag_n(cpu);
   447	    int z = jit_flag_z(cpu);
   448	    switch (cond & 0x0F) {
   449	    case 0x0: return 1;                 /* T  */
   450	    case 0x1: return 0;                 /* F  */
   451	    case 0x2: return (!c) && (!z);      /* HI */
   452	    case 0x3: return c || z;            /* LS */
   453	    case 0x4: return !c;                /* CC */
   454	    case 0x5: return c;                 /* CS */
   455	    case 0x6: return !z;                /* NE */
   456	    case 0x7: return z;                 /* EQ */
   457	    case 0x8: return !v;                /* VC */
   458	    case 0x9: return v;                 /* VS */
   459	    case 0xA: return !n;                /* PL */
   460	    case 0xB: return n;                 /* MI */
   461	    case 0xC: return n == v;            /* GE */
   462	    case 0xD: return n != v;            /* LT */
   463	    case 0xE: return (!z) && (n == v);  /* GT */
   464	    case 0xF: return z || (n != v);     /* LE */
   465	    default: return 0;
   466	    }
   467	}
   468	
   469	static int jit_cycles_base(const m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, uint16_t opcode)
   470	{
   471	    int c = (int)cpu->cyc_instruction[opcode];
   472	    return (c > 0) ? c : 1;
   473	}
   474	
   475	static void jit_flags_add_32(m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst, uint32_t res)
   476	{
   477	    uint64_t wide = (uint64_t)src + (uint64_t)dst;
   478	    cpu->n_flag = (res >> 24) & 0x80;
   479	    cpu->v_flag = (((src ^ res) & (dst ^ res)) >> 24) & 0x80;
   480	    cpu->c_flag = cpu->x_flag = (wide >> 32) ? 0x100 : 0;
   481	    cpu->not_z_flag = res;
   482	}
   483	
   484	static void jit_flags_add_16(m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, uint16_t src, uint16_t dst, uint16_t res)
   485	{
   486	    uint32_t wide = (uint32_t)src + (uint32_t)dst;
   487	    cpu->n_flag = (res >> 8) & 0x80;
   488	    cpu->v_flag = (((src ^ res) & (dst ^ res)) >> 8) & 0x80;
   489	    cpu->c_flag = cpu->x_flag = (wide & 0x10000u) ? 0x100 : 0;
   490	    cpu->not_z_flag = res;
   491	}
   492	
   493	static void jit_flags_add_8(m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, uint8_t src, uint8_t dst, uint8_t res, uint16_t wide)
   494	{
   495	    cpu->n_flag = res & 0x80;
   496	    cpu->v_flag = ((src ^ res) & (dst ^ res)) & 0x80;
   497	    cpu->c_flag = cpu->x_flag = (wide & 0x100u) ? 0x100 : 0;
   498	    cpu->not_z_flag = res;
   499	}
   500	
   501	static int jit_try_fast_step(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc, int cycles_budget)
   502	{
   503	    m68ki_cpu_core *cpu;
   504	    uint16_t opcode;
   505	    uint8_t fc_prog;
   506	    uint8_t fc_data;
   507	
   508	    if (!jit || !jit->cpu || cycles_budget <= 0) {
   509	        return 0;
   510	    }
   511	
   512	    cpu = jit->cpu;
   513	    fc_prog = jit_get_fc(cpu->s_flag ? 1 : 0, 1);
   514	    fc_data = jit_get_fc(cpu->s_flag ? 1 : 0, 0);
   515	    opcode = jit_fetch_word(pc, fc_prog);
   516	
   517	    /* Bcc/BRA (8-bit and 16-bit displacement), excluding BSR. */
   518	    if ((opcode & 0xF000) == 0x6000) {
   519	        uint8_t cond = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 8) & 0x0F);
   520	        int taken;
   521	        int cycles = jit_cycles_base(cpu, opcode);
   522	        if (cond == 0x1) {
   523	            return 0; /* BSR not handled here yet. */
   524	        }
   525	        taken = jit_eval_cond(cpu, cond);
   526	        if ((opcode & 0x00FF) == 0x00) {
   527	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)jit_fetch_word(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   528	            cpu->pc = taken ? (uint32_t)(pc + 2 + disp) : (pc + 4);
   529	            if (!taken) cycles += cpu->cyc_bcc_notake_w;
   530	        } else {
   531	            int8_t disp = (int8_t)(opcode & 0x00FF);
   532	            cpu->pc = taken ? (uint32_t)(pc + 2 + disp) : (pc + 2);
   533	            if (!taken) cycles += cpu->cyc_bcc_notake_b;
   534	        }
   535	        jit->current_pc = cpu->pc;
   536	        return (cycles > 0) ? cycles : 1;
   537	    }
   538	
   539	    /* DBcc */
   540	    if ((opcode & 0xF0F8) == 0x50C8) {
   541	        uint8_t cond = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 8) & 0x0F);
   542	        uint8_t dn = opcode & 0x07;
   543	        int16_t disp = (int16_t)jit_fetch_word(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   544	        int cycles = jit_cycles_base(cpu, opcode);
   545	        if (!jit_eval_cond(cpu, cond)) {
   546	            uint16_t ctr = (uint16_t)((cpu->dar[dn] - 1) & 0xFFFFu);
   547	            cpu->dar[dn] = (cpu->dar[dn] & 0xFFFF0000u) | ctr;
   548	            if (ctr != 0xFFFFu) {
   549	                cpu->pc = (uint32_t)(pc + 2 + disp);
   550	                cycles += cpu->cyc_dbcc_f_noexp;
   551	            } else {
   552	                cpu->pc = pc + 4;
   553	                cycles += cpu->cyc_dbcc_f_exp;
   554	            }
   555	        } else {
   556	            cpu->pc = pc + 4;
   557	        }
   558	        jit->current_pc = cpu->pc;
   559	        return (cycles > 0) ? cycles : 1;
   560	    }
   561	
   562	    /* ADDQ */
   563	    if ((opcode & 0xF100) == 0x5000) {
   564	        uint8_t imm = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 9) & 7);
   565	        uint8_t sz = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 6) & 3);
   566	        uint8_t mode = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 3) & 7);
   567	        uint8_t reg = opcode & 7;
   568	        int cycles = jit_cycles_base(cpu, opcode);
   569	        if (imm == 0) imm = 8;
   570	
   571	        if (mode == 0) { /* Dn */
   572	            uint32_t d = cpu->dar[reg];
   573	            if (sz == 0) {
   574	                uint8_t dst = (uint8_t)d;
   575	                uint16_t wide = (uint16_t)dst + imm;
   576	                uint8_t res = (uint8_t)wide;
   577	                cpu->dar[reg] = (d & 0xFFFFFF00u) | res;
   578	                jit_flags_add_8(cpu, imm, dst, res, wide);
   579	            } else if (sz == 1) {
   580	                uint16_t dst = (uint16_t)d;
   581	                uint16_t res = (uint16_t)(dst + imm);
   582	                cpu->dar[reg] = (d & 0xFFFF0000u) | res;
   583	                jit_flags_add_16(cpu, imm, dst, res);
   584	            } else if (sz == 2) {
   585	                uint32_t dst = d;
   586	                uint32_t res = dst + imm;
   587	                cpu->dar[reg] = res;
   588	                jit_flags_add_32(cpu, imm, dst, res);
   589	            } else {
   590	                return 0;
   591	            }
   592	        } else if (mode == 1) { /* An */
   593	            if (sz == 1 || sz == 2) {
   594	                cpu->dar[8 + reg] = cpu->dar[8 + reg] + imm;
   595	            } else {
   596	                return 0;
   597	            }
   598	        } else {
   599	            return 0;
   600	        }
   601	
   602	        cpu->pc = pc + 2;
   603	        jit->current_pc = cpu->pc;
   604	        return (cycles > 0) ? cycles : 1;
   605	    }
   606	
   607	    /* LEA */
   608	    if ((opcode & 0xF1C0) == 0x41C0) {
   609	        uint8_t an = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 9) & 7);
   610	        uint8_t mode = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 3) & 7);
   611	        uint8_t reg = opcode & 7;
   612	        uint32_t ea;
   613	        int cycles = jit_cycles_base(cpu, opcode);
   614	
   615	        if (mode == 7 && reg == 0) { /* abs.w */
   616	            ea = (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)jit_fetch_word(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   617	            cpu->pc = pc + 4;
   618	        } else if (mode == 7 && reg == 1) { /* abs.l */
   619	            ea = jit_fetch_long(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   620	            cpu->pc = pc + 6;
   621	        } else if (mode == 2) { /* (An) */
   622	            ea = cpu->dar[8 + reg];
   623	            cpu->pc = pc + 2;
   624	        } else if (mode == 5) { /* (d16,An) */
   625	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)jit_fetch_word(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   626	            ea = cpu->dar[8 + reg] + (int32_t)disp;
   627	            cpu->pc = pc + 4;
   628	        } else if (mode == 7 && reg == 2) { /* (d16,PC) */
   629	            int16_t disp = (int16_t)jit_fetch_word(pc + 2, fc_prog);
   630	            ea = (uint32_t)(pc + 2 + (int32_t)disp);
   631	            cpu->pc = pc + 4;
   632	        } else {
   633	            return 0;
   634	        }
   635	
   636	        cpu->dar[8 + an] = ea;
   637	        jit->current_pc = cpu->pc;
   638	        return (cycles > 0) ? cycles : 1;
   639	    }
   640	
   641	    /* ADD.L <ea>,Dn (limited: Dn/(An)/(An)+ source forms) */
   642	    if ((opcode & 0xF1C0) == 0xD080) {
   643	        uint8_t dn = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 9) & 7);
   644	        uint8_t opmode = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 6) & 7);
   645	        uint8_t mode = (uint8_t)((opcode >> 3) & 7);
   646	        uint8_t reg = opcode & 7;
   647	        uint32_t src, dst, res;
   648	        int cycles = jit_cycles_base(cpu, opcode);
   649	
   650	        if (opmode != 2) {
   651	            return 0;
   652	        }
   653	
   654	        if (mode == 0) { /* Dn */
   655	            src = cpu->dar[reg];
   656	        } else if (mode == 2) { /* (An) */
   657	            if (jit_mem_read32(cpu->dar[8 + reg], fc_data, &src) != 0) return 0;
   658	        } else if (mode == 3) { /* (An)+ */
   659	            if (jit_mem_read32(cpu->dar[8 + reg], fc_data, &src) != 0) return 0;
   660	            cpu->dar[8 + reg] += 4;
   661	        } else {
   662	            return 0;
   663	        }
   664	
   665	        dst = cpu->dar[dn];
   666	        res = dst + src;
   667	        cpu->dar[dn] = res;
   668	        jit_flags_add_32(cpu, src, dst, res);
   669	        cpu->pc = pc + 2;
   670	        jit->current_pc = cpu->pc;
   671	        return (cycles > 0) ? cycles : 1;
   672	    }
   673	
   674	    return 0;
   675	}
   676	
   677	static void jit_trace_fallback(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc_before, const char *reason)
   678	{
   679	    static int trace_enabled = -1;
   680	    static int trace_cached = -1;
   681	    static unsigned int trace_count = 0;
   682	    const unsigned int trace_limit = 64;
   683	    uint8_t fc;
   684	    uint16_t opcode;
   685	    uint32_t sr;
   686	    const jit_opinfo_t *opinfo;
   687	
   688	    if (!jit || !jit->cpu) {
   689	        return;
   690	    }
   691	
   692	    if (trace_enabled < 0) {
   693	        const char *e = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_TRACE_FALLBACK");
   694	        trace_enabled = (e && atoi(e) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
   695	    }
   696	    if (trace_cached < 0) {
   697	        const char *e = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_TRACE_FALLBACK_CACHED");
   698	        trace_cached = (e && atoi(e) != 0) ? 1 : 0;
   699	    }
   700	    if (!trace_enabled || trace_count >= trace_limit) {
   701	        return;
   702	    }
   703	    if (!trace_cached && reason && strstr(reason, "cached") != NULL) {
   704	        return;
   705	    }
   706	
   707	    sr = (uint32_t)m68k_get_reg(jit->cpu, M68K_REG_SR);
   708	    fc = jit_get_fc((sr & 0x2000u) ? 1 : 0, 1);
   709	    opcode = jit_fetch_word(pc_before, fc);
   710	    opinfo = jit_get_opinfo(opcode);
   711	
   712	    LOG_INFO("[CPU][m68xkcpu] fallback[%u] reason=%s pc=0x%08X fc=%u opcode=0x%04X family=%u ext=%u flags=0x%02X\n",
   713	             trace_count + 1, reason ? reason : "unknown", pc_before, (unsigned)fc,
   714	             (unsigned)opcode, (unsigned)opinfo->family, (unsigned)opinfo->ext_words,
   715	             (unsigned)opinfo->flags);
   716	    trace_count++;
   717	}
   718	
   719	static int jit_pc_preflight(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc, const char **reason_out)
   720	{
   721	    uint8_t fc_prog;
   722	    uint16_t probe = 0;
   723	
   724	    if (!jit || !jit->cpu) {
   725	        if (reason_out) {
   726	            *reason_out = "no-cpu";
   727	        }
   728	        return 0;
   729	    }
   730	
   731	    if (pc & 1u) {
   732	        if (reason_out) {
   733	            *reason_out = "odd-pc";
   734	        }
   735	        return 0;
   736	    }
   737	
   738	    /* Keep low-vector exception space on Musashi for now. */
   739	    if (pc < 0x00000400u) {
   740	        if (reason_out) {
   741	            *reason_out = "vector-space";
   742	        }
   743	        return 0;
   744	    }
   745	
   746	    fc_prog = jit_get_fc(jit->cpu->s_flag ? 1 : 0, 1);
   747	    if (jit_mem_read16(pc, fc_prog, &probe) != 0) {
   748	        if (reason_out) {
   749	            *reason_out = "pc-read-fault";
   750	        }
   751	        return 0;
   752	    }
   753	
   754	    return 1;
   755	}
   756	
   757	static void jit_mark_interpret_only_pc(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc, const char *reason)
   758	{
   759	    jit_block_t *existing;
   760	    jit_block_t *iblock;
   761	
   762	    if (!jit) {
   763	        return;
   764	    }
   765	
   766	    existing = jit_cache_lookup(jit, pc);
   767	    if (existing != NULL) {
   768	        if (existing->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   769	            return;
   770	        }
   771	        jit_cache_remove(jit, existing);
   772	        jit_block_free(jit, existing);
   773	    }
   774	
   775	    if (!jit_cache_should_add_interpret_block(jit)) {
   776	        jit_cache_evict_oldest_interpret_block(jit);
   777	    }
   778	
   779	    iblock = jit_block_alloc(jit, pc);
   780	    if (!iblock) {
   781	        return;
   782	    }
   783	    iblock->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
   784	    iblock->instruction_count = 0;
   785	    iblock->end_pc = pc;
   786	    iblock->ends_block = 1;
   787	    jit_cache_insert(jit, iblock);
   788	    jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count++;
   789	
   790	    if (jit_trace_blocks_enabled()) {
   791	        LOG_INFO("[CPU][m68xkcpu][BLOCK] phase=mark-interpret origin=hotpc entry=0x%08X exit=0x%08X "
   792	                 "block_cycles=0 flags=0x%04X ends_block=%u icount=%u note=%s\n",
   793	                 pc, pc, (unsigned)iblock->flags, (unsigned)iblock->ends_block,
   794	                 (unsigned)iblock->instruction_count, reason ? reason : "hot-pc");
   795	    }
   796	}
   797	
   798	/**
   799	 * Initialize the JIT subsystem
   800	 * 
   801	 * @param cpu Pointer to the Musashi CPU state
   802	 * @param cache_size Size of the code cache in bytes
   803	 * @return 0 on success, -1 on failure
   804	 */
   805	int jit_init(struct m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, size_t cache_size)
   806	{
   807	#if !defined(__aarch64__)
   808	    (void)cpu;
   809	    (void)cache_size;
   810	    fprintf(stderr, "JIT: m68xkcpu backend currently requires an AArch64 host\n");
   811	    return -1;
   812	#else
   813	    if (g_jit.initialized) {
   814	        fprintf(stderr, "JIT: Already initialized\n");
   815	        return -1;
   816	    }
   817	
   818	    /* Install SIGILL handler for debugging */
   819	    jit_install_signal_handler();
   820	    
   821	    memset(&g_jit, 0, sizeof(g_jit));
   822	    memset(&g_jit_progress, 0, sizeof(g_jit_progress));
   823	    
   824	    g_jit.cpu = cpu;
   825	    g_jit.cache_size = cache_size > 0 ? cache_size : JIT_CACHE_SIZE;
   826	    
   827	    /* Initialize cache */
   828	    if (jit_cache_init(&g_jit) != 0) {
   829	        fprintf(stderr, "JIT: Failed to initialize code cache\n");
   830	        return -1;
   831	    }
   832	    
   833	    /* Initialize hash table */
   834	    memset(g_jit.hash_table, 0, sizeof(g_jit.hash_table));
   835	    
   836	    g_jit.enabled = true;
   837	    g_jit.initialized = true;
   838	    g_jit.mmu_state_sig = 0;
   839	    g_jit.mmu_state_valid = false;
   840	
   841	    /* Emit startup policy once so strict-vs-fallback mode is explicit in logs. */
   842	    (void)jit_no_fallback_enabled();
   843	    
   844	    printf("JIT: Initialized with %zu KB cache\n", g_jit.cache_size / 1024);
   845	    
   846	    return 0;
   847	#endif
   848	}
   849	
   850	
   851	/**
   852	 * Shutdown the JIT subsystem
   853	 */
   854	void jit_shutdown(void)
   855	{
   856	    if (!g_jit.initialized) {
   857	        return;
   858	    }
   859	
   860	    {
   861	        const char *e = getenv("PISTORM_M68XK_STATS");
   862	        if (e && atoi(e) != 0) {
   863	            jit_print_stats();
   864	        }
   865	    }
   866	    
   867	    jit_cache_shutdown(&g_jit);
   868	    
   869	    memset(&g_jit, 0, sizeof(g_jit));
   870	    
   871	    printf("JIT: Shutdown complete\n");
   872	}
   873	
   874	
   875	/**
   876	 * Reset JIT state (called on CPU reset)
   877	 */
   878	void jit_reset(void)
   879	{
   880	    if (!g_jit.initialized) {
   881	        return;
   882	    }
   883	    
   884	    /* Invalidate all compiled blocks on reset */
   885	    jit_invalidate_all();
   886	    g_jit.mmu_state_sig = 0;
   887	    g_jit.mmu_state_valid = false;
   888	    memset(&g_jit_progress, 0, sizeof(g_jit_progress));
   889	    
   890	    printf("JIT: Reset complete\n");
   891	}
   892	
   893	
   894	/**
   895	 * Execute code starting at the given PC
   896	 * 
   897	 * @param pc Program counter to start execution at
   898	 * @param cycles Maximum cycles to execute
   899	 * @return Number of cycles executed, or negative on error
   900	 */
   901	int jit_execute(uint32_t pc, int cycles)
   902	{
   903	    jit_block_t *block;
   904	    int cycles_remaining = cycles;
   905	    jit_progress_tracker_t *progress = &g_jit_progress;
   906	    
   907	    if (!g_jit.initialized || !g_jit.enabled) {
   908	        return -1;
   909	    }
   910	    
   911	    /* DEBUG: Log entry */
   912	    LOG_INFO("[JIT-EXEC-ENTRY] pc=0x%08X cycles=%d\n", pc, cycles);
   913	    
   914	    /* Sync PC to CPU struct */
   915	    g_jit.cpu->pc = pc;
   916	    g_jit.current_pc = pc;
   917	    
   918	    /* Main execution loop */
   919	    while (cycles_remaining > 0) {
   920	        /* 68040 MMU control changes must invalidate stale translated blocks. */
   921	        jit_refresh_mmu_tracking(&g_jit);
   922	
   923	        /* Look up compiled block - use PC from CPU struct for consistency */
   924	        pc = g_jit.cpu->pc;
   925	        {
   926	            const char *preflight_reason = NULL;
   927	            if (!jit_pc_preflight(&g_jit, pc, &preflight_reason)) {
   928	                int ran;
   929	                g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
   930	                jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc, preflight_reason ? preflight_reason : "pc-preflight");
   931	                jit_mark_interpret_only_pc(&g_jit, pc, preflight_reason ? preflight_reason : "pc-preflight");
   932	                ran = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
   933	                if (ran <= 0) {
   934	                    break;
   935	                }
   936	                jit_trace_block_exec("fallback", "pc-preflight", pc, g_jit.current_pc, ran, NULL,
   937	                                     preflight_reason ? preflight_reason : "pc-preflight");
   938	                cycles_remaining -= ran;
   939	                pc = g_jit.current_pc;
   940	                continue;
   941	            }
   942	        }
   943	        block = jit_cache_lookup(&g_jit, pc);
   944	        
   945	        if (block != NULL) {
   946	            if (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   947	                uint32_t pc_before = pc;
   948	                int ran;
   949	                ran = jit_faststep_enabled() ? jit_try_fast_step(&g_jit, pc, cycles_remaining) : 0;
   950	                if (ran > 0) {
   951	                    g_jit.stats.fast_step_count++;
   952	                    cycles_remaining -= ran;
   953	                    pc = g_jit.current_pc;
   954	                    continue;
   955	                }
   956	                g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
   957	                jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc, "cached interpret-only -> musashi");
   958	                ran = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
   959	                if (ran <= 0) {
   960	                    break;
   961	                }
   962	                (void)jit_progress_update_and_detect(progress, pc_before, g_jit.current_pc);
   963	                jit_trace_block_exec("fallback", "cached-interpret", pc, g_jit.current_pc, ran, block,
   964	                                     "cached interpret-only");
   965	                cycles_remaining -= ran;
   966	                pc = g_jit.current_pc;
   967	                continue;
   968	            }
   969	
   970	            /* Block found - execute compiled code */
   971	            g_jit.stats.cache_hits++;
   972	            g_jit.stats.blocks_executed++;
   973	            
   974	            /* Execute the compiled block */
   975	            uint32_t pc_before = g_jit.cpu->pc;
   976	            const char *loop_reason = NULL;
   977	            jit_trace_block_exec("enter", "cached", pc_before, 0, cycles_remaining, block, NULL);
   978	            int block_cycles = jit_block_execute(block, cycles_remaining);
   979	            
   980	            /* Read updated PC from CPU struct after execution */
   981	            uint32_t pc_after = g_jit.cpu->pc;
   982	            g_jit.current_pc = pc_after;
   983	            jit_trace_block_exec("exit", "cached", pc_before, pc_after, block_cycles, block, NULL);
   984	            loop_reason = jit_progress_update_and_detect(progress, pc_before, pc_after);
   985	            
   986	            if (block_cycles <= 0 || pc_after == pc_before || loop_reason != NULL) {
   987	                /* Discard non-progress block and execute via interpreter fallback. */
   988	                g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
   989	                jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc_before,
   990	                                   loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress cached block");
   991	                jit_trace_block_exec("evict", "cached", pc_before, pc_after, block_cycles, block,
   992	                                     loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress");
   993	                jit_cache_remove(&g_jit, block);
   994	                jit_block_free(&g_jit, block);
   995	                jit_mark_interpret_only_pc(&g_jit, pc_before, loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress");
   996	                block_cycles = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
   997	                if (block_cycles <= 0) {
   998	                    break;
   999	                }
  1000	                cycles_remaining -= block_cycles;
  1001	                pc = g_jit.cpu->pc;
  1002	                memset(progress, 0, sizeof(*progress));
  1003	                continue;
  1004	            }
  1005	            
  1006	            cycles_remaining -= block_cycles;
  1007	            
  1008	            /* Update PC after block execution */
  1009	            pc = pc_after;
  1010	            
  1011	            /* Check if block ended with a branch/exception */
  1012	            if (block->ends_block) {
  1013	                /* Continue to next block */
  1014	                continue;
  1015	            }
  1016	        } else {
  1017	            /* Block not found - compile or interpret */
  1018	            g_jit.stats.cache_misses++;
  1019	            
  1020	            /* Try to compile the block */
  1021	            block = jit_compile_block(pc);
  1022	            
  1023	            if (block != NULL) {
  1024	                if (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
  1025	                    uint32_t pc_before = pc;
  1026	                    int ran;
  1027	                    ran = jit_faststep_enabled() ? jit_try_fast_step(&g_jit, pc, cycles_remaining) : 0;
  1028	                    if (ran > 0) {
  1029	                        g_jit.stats.fast_step_count++;
  1030	                        cycles_remaining -= ran;
  1031	                        pc = g_jit.current_pc;
  1032	                        continue;
  1033	                    }
  1034	                    g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
  1035	                    jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc, "new interpret-only -> musashi");
  1036	                    ran = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
  1037	                    if (ran <= 0) {
  1038	                        break;
  1039	                    }
  1040	                    (void)jit_progress_update_and_detect(progress, pc_before, g_jit.current_pc);
  1041	                    jit_trace_block_exec("fallback", "new-interpret", pc, g_jit.current_pc, ran, block,
  1042	                                         "new interpret-only");
  1043	                    cycles_remaining -= ran;
  1044	                    pc = g_jit.current_pc;
  1045	                    continue;
  1046	                }
  1047	
  1048	                /* Successfully compiled - execute it */
  1049	                g_jit.stats.blocks_compiled++;
  1050	                
  1051	                uint32_t pc_before = g_jit.cpu->pc;
  1052	                const char *loop_reason = NULL;
  1053	                jit_trace_block_exec("enter", "new", pc_before, 0, cycles_remaining, block, NULL);
  1054	                int block_cycles = jit_block_execute(block, cycles_remaining);
  1055	                
  1056	                /* Read updated PC from CPU struct after execution */
  1057	                uint32_t pc_after = g_jit.cpu->pc;
  1058	                g_jit.current_pc = pc_after;
  1059	                jit_trace_block_exec("exit", "new", pc_before, pc_after, block_cycles, block, NULL);
  1060	                loop_reason = jit_progress_update_and_detect(progress, pc_before, pc_after);
  1061	                
  1062	                if (block_cycles <= 0 || pc_after == pc_before || loop_reason != NULL) {
  1063	                    /* Discard non-progress block and execute via interpreter fallback. */
  1064	                    g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
  1065	                    jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc_before,
  1066	                                       loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress compiled block");
  1067	                    jit_trace_block_exec("evict", "new", pc_before, pc_after, block_cycles, block,
  1068	                                         loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress");
  1069	                    jit_cache_remove(&g_jit, block);
  1070	                    jit_block_free(&g_jit, block);
  1071	                    jit_mark_interpret_only_pc(&g_jit, pc_before, loop_reason ? loop_reason : "non-progress");
  1072	                    block_cycles = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
  1073	                    if (block_cycles <= 0) {
  1074	                        break;
  1075	                    }
  1076	                    cycles_remaining -= block_cycles;
  1077	                    pc = g_jit.cpu->pc;
  1078	                    memset(progress, 0, sizeof(*progress));
  1079	                    continue;
  1080	                }
  1081	                
  1082	                cycles_remaining -= block_cycles;
  1083	                pc = pc_after;
  1084	            } else {
  1085	                /* Compilation failed - try fast-step first, then interpreter fallback. */
  1086	                int ran = jit_faststep_enabled() ? jit_try_fast_step(&g_jit, pc, cycles_remaining) : 0;
  1087	                if (ran > 0) {
  1088	                    g_jit.stats.fast_step_count++;
  1089	                    cycles_remaining -= ran;
  1090	                    pc = g_jit.current_pc;
  1091	                    continue;
  1092	                }
  1093	                g_jit.stats.fallback_count++;
  1094	                {
  1095	                    char reason[96];
  1096	                    snprintf(reason, sizeof(reason), "compile failed(%s) -> musashi",
  1097	                             g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason ? g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason : "unknown");
  1098	                    jit_trace_fallback(&g_jit, pc, reason);
  1099	                    jit_mark_interpret_only_pc(&g_jit, pc,
  1100	                                               g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason ? g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason : "compile-fail");
  1101	                }
  1102	                ran = jit_fallback_interpreter_step(&g_jit, cycles_remaining);
  1103	                if (ran <= 0) {
  1104	                    break;
  1105	                }
  1106	                jit_trace_block_exec("fallback", "compile-fail", pc, g_jit.current_pc, ran, NULL,
  1107	                                     g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason ? g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason : "compile-fail");
  1108	                cycles_remaining -= ran;
  1109	                pc = g_jit.current_pc;
  1110	                continue;
  1111	            }
  1112	        }
  1113	    }
  1114	    
  1115	    return cycles - cycles_remaining;
  1116	}
  1117	
  1118	
  1119	/**
  1120	 * Invalidate a range of addresses in the JIT cache
  1121	 * 
  1122	 * Called when memory is written to, to invalidate any compiled
  1123	 * blocks that overlap with the modified range.
  1124	 * 
  1125	 * @param start_addr Start address of modified range
  1126	 * @param end_addr End address of modified range
  1127	 */
  1128	void jit_invalidate_range(uint32_t start_addr, uint32_t end_addr)
  1129	{
  1130	    if (!g_jit.initialized) {
  1131	        return;
  1132	    }
  1133	    
  1134	    /* Walk through all blocks and invalidate those in range */
  1135	    for (int i = 0; i < JIT_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
  1136	        jit_block_t *block = g_jit.hash_table[i];
  1137	        jit_block_t *next;
  1138	        
  1139	        while (block != NULL) {
  1140	            next = block->hash_next;
  1141	            
  1142	            /* Check if block overlaps with invalidated range */
  1143	            if (block->start_pc >= start_addr && block->start_pc < end_addr) {
  1144	                jit_block_invalidate(&g_jit, block);
  1145	                g_jit.stats.cache_invalidations++;
  1146	            }
  1147	            
  1148	            block = next;
  1149	        }
  1150	    }
  1151	}
  1152	
  1153	
  1154	/**
  1155	 * Invalidate all compiled blocks
  1156	 */
  1157	void jit_invalidate_all(void)
  1158	{
  1159	    if (!g_jit.initialized) {
  1160	        return;
  1161	    }
  1162	    
  1163	    /* Clear hash table */
  1164	    for (int i = 0; i < JIT_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
  1165	        g_jit.hash_table[i] = NULL;
  1166	    }
  1167	    
  1168	    /* Reset cache pointer (all blocks invalid) */
  1169	    jit_cache_reset(&g_jit);
  1170	    
  1171	    g_jit.stats.cache_invalidations++;
  1172	}
  1173	
  1174	
  1175	/**
  1176	 * Print JIT statistics
  1177	 */
  1178	void jit_print_stats(void)
  1179	{
  1180	    if (!g_jit.initialized) {
  1181	        printf("JIT: Not initialized\n");
  1182	        return;
  1183	    }
  1184	    
  1185	    printf("\n=== JIT Statistics ===\n");
  1186	    printf("Blocks compiled:      %u\n", g_jit.stats.blocks_compiled);
  1187	    printf("Blocks executed:      %u\n", g_jit.stats.blocks_executed);
  1188	    printf("Cache hits:           %u\n", g_jit.stats.cache_hits);
  1189	    printf("Cache misses:         %u\n", g_jit.stats.cache_misses);
  1190	    printf("Fast-step count:      %u\n", g_jit.stats.fast_step_count);
  1191	    printf("Fallback count:       %u\n", g_jit.stats.fallback_count);
  1192	    printf("Cache invalidations:  %u\n", g_jit.stats.cache_invalidations);
  1193	    printf("Interpret blocks:     %u (max %d)\n", 
  1194	           g_jit.stats.interpret_blocks_count, JIT_MAX_INTERPRET_BLOCKS);
  1195	    printf("Interpret evictions:  %u\n", g_jit.stats.interpret_blocks_evicted);
  1196	    printf("Cache bytes used:     %zu / %zu\n", 
  1197	           g_jit.stats.cache_bytes_used, g_jit.cache_size);
  1198	    printf("Cache bytes free:     %zu\n", g_jit.stats.cache_bytes_free);
  1199	    
  1200	    if (g_jit.stats.cache_hits + g_jit.stats.cache_misses > 0) {
  1201	        double hit_rate = (double)g_jit.stats.cache_hits / 
  1202	                         (g_jit.stats.cache_hits + g_jit.stats.cache_misses) * 100.0;
  1203	        printf("Cache hit rate:       %.2f%%\n", hit_rate);
  1204	    }
  1205	    
  1206	    printf("======================\n\n");
  1207	}
  1208	
  1209	
  1210	/**
  1211	 * Compile a basic block starting at the given PC
  1212	 * 
  1213	 * @param pc Program counter to start compilation at
  1214	 * @return Pointer to compiled block, or NULL on failure
  1215	 */
  1216	jit_block_t *jit_compile_block(uint32_t pc)
  1217	{
  1218	    jit_block_t *block;
  1219	    g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = "unknown";
  1220	
  1221	    {
  1222	        const char *preflight_reason = NULL;
  1223	        if (!jit_pc_preflight(&g_jit, pc, &preflight_reason)) {
  1224	            g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = preflight_reason ? preflight_reason : "pc-preflight";
  1225	            return NULL;
  1226	        }
  1227	    }
  1228	    
  1229	    /* Allocate a new block structure */
  1230	    block = jit_block_alloc(&g_jit, pc);
  1231	    if (block == NULL) {
  1232	        g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = "alloc";
  1233	        return NULL;
  1234	    }
  1235	
  1236	    if (jit_safe_interp_enabled()) {
  1237	        /* Check interpret block limit to prevent unbounded growth */
  1238	        if (!jit_cache_should_add_interpret_block(&g_jit)) {
  1239	            /* Limit reached - evict an old interpret block */
  1240	            jit_cache_evict_oldest_interpret_block(&g_jit);
  1241	        }
  1242	        
  1243	        block->flags |= JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY;
  1244	        block->instruction_count = 0;
  1245	        block->end_pc = pc;
  1246	        block->ends_block = 1;
  1247	        jit_cache_insert(&g_jit, block);
  1248	        g_jit.stats.interpret_blocks_count++;
  1249	        g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = NULL;
  1250	        return block;
  1251	    }
  1252	    
  1253	    /* Translate instructions until we hit a block boundary */
  1254	    if (jit_block_translate(&g_jit, block) != 0) {
  1255	        /* Translation failed - free the block */
  1256	        jit_block_free(&g_jit, block);
  1257	        g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = "translate";
  1258	        return NULL;
  1259	    }
  1260	    
  1261	    /* Emit the compiled code */
  1262	    if (jit_block_emit(&g_jit, block) != 0) {
  1263	        /* Emission failed - free the block */
  1264	        jit_block_free(&g_jit, block);
  1265	        g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = "emit";
  1266	        return NULL;
  1267	    }
  1268	    
  1269	    /* Insert block into cache */
  1270	    jit_cache_insert(&g_jit, block);
  1271	    g_jit_last_compile_fail_reason = NULL;
  1272	    
  1273	    return block;
  1274	}


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_cache.c -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Cache Implementation
     3	 * 
     4	 * Manages the code cache for compiled blocks.
     5	 */
     6	
     7	#include "jit.h"
     8	#include "jit_cache.h"
     9	#include "log.h"
    10	#include <stdio.h>
    11	#include <stdlib.h>
    12	#include <string.h>
    13	#include <sys/mman.h>
    14	#include <errno.h>
    15	
    16	/* Hash function for PC lookup */
    17	static inline uint32_t jit_cache_hash_pc(uint32_t pc)
    18	{
    19	    uint32_t hash = pc * 2654435761u;
    20	    return (hash >> 16) & (JIT_HASH_SIZE - 1);
    21	}
    22	
    23	
    24	/**
    25	 * Initialize the code cache
    26	 * 
    27	 * Allocates executable memory for compiled code.
    28	 * 
    29	 * @param jit JIT context
    30	 * @return 0 on success, -1 on failure
    31	 */
    32	int jit_cache_init(jit_context_t *jit)
    33	{
    34	    void *cache;
    35	    
    36	    if (jit == NULL || jit->cache_size == 0) {
    37	        return -1;
    38	    }
    39	    
    40	    /* Allocate executable memory using mmap */
    41	    cache = mmap(NULL, jit->cache_size,
    42	                 PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC,
    43	                 MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS,
    44	                 -1, 0);
    45	    
    46	    if (cache == MAP_FAILED) {
    47	        LOG_ERROR("[CPU] m68xkcpu: mmap failed for code cache (%s)\n", strerror(errno));
    48	        return -1;
    49	    }
    50	    
    51	    jit->cache_base = (uint8_t *)cache;
    52	    jit->cache_ptr = jit->cache_base;
    53	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_used = 0;
    54	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_free = jit->cache_size;
    55	    
    56	    return 0;
    57	}
    58	
    59	
    60	/**
    61	 * Shutdown the code cache
    62	 * 
    63	 * Frees the executable memory.
    64	 * 
    65	 * @param jit JIT context
    66	 */
    67	void jit_cache_shutdown(jit_context_t *jit)
    68	{
    69	    if (jit == NULL || jit->cache_base == NULL) {
    70	        return;
    71	    }
    72	    
    73	    munmap(jit->cache_base, jit->cache_size);
    74	    
    75	    jit->cache_base = NULL;
    76	    jit->cache_ptr = NULL;
    77	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_used = 0;
    78	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_free = 0;
    79	}
    80	
    81	
    82	/**
    83	 * Reset the cache
    84	 * 
    85	 * Invalidates all blocks by resetting the allocation pointer.
    86	 * Note: This doesn't actually free individual blocks - it just
    87	 * marks all space as available again.
    88	 * 
    89	 * @param jit JIT context
    90	 */
    91	void jit_cache_reset(jit_context_t *jit)
    92	{
    93	    if (jit == NULL || jit->cache_base == NULL) {
    94	        return;
    95	    }
    96	    
    97	    jit->cache_ptr = jit->cache_base;
    98	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_used = 0;
    99	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_free = jit->cache_size;
   100	}
   101	
   102	
   103	/**
   104	 * Allocate space in the cache
   105	 * 
   106	 * Uses a simple bump allocator - no free list management.
   107	 * For a production JIT, you'd want a more sophisticated allocator.
   108	 * 
   109	 * @param jit JIT context
   110	 * @param size Number of bytes to allocate
   111	 * @return Pointer to allocated space, or NULL if insufficient space
   112	 */
   113	void *jit_cache_alloc(jit_context_t *jit, size_t size)
   114	{
   115	    uint8_t *ptr;
   116	    
   117	    if (jit == NULL || jit->cache_base == NULL) {
   118	        return NULL;
   119	    }
   120	    
   121	    /* Align to 16 bytes for AArch64 */
   122	    size = (size + 15) & ~15;
   123	    
   124	    /* Check if we have enough space */
   125	    if (jit->cache_ptr + size > jit->cache_base + jit->cache_size) {
   126	        /* Cache full - could trigger GC in a more sophisticated implementation */
   127	        return NULL;
   128	    }
   129	    
   130	    ptr = jit->cache_ptr;
   131	    jit->cache_ptr += size;
   132	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_used += size;
   133	    jit->stats.cache_bytes_free -= size;
   134	    
   135	    return ptr;
   136	}
   137	
   138	
   139	/**
   140	 * Free space in the cache
   141	 * 
   142	 * In this simple implementation, we don't actually free space.
   143	 * A production JIT would maintain a free list or use a region-based
   144	 * allocator.
   145	 * 
   146	 * @param jit JIT context
   147	 * @param ptr Pointer to free (ignored in simple implementation)
   148	 * @param size Size of allocation (ignored in simple implementation)
   149	 */
   150	void jit_cache_free(jit_context_t *jit, void *ptr, size_t size)
   151	{
   152	    uint8_t *p;
   153	    size_t aligned;
   154	    if (jit == NULL || ptr == NULL || size == 0) {
   155	        return;
   156	    }
   157	
   158	    /* Opportunistic LIFO reclaim for top-of-cache frees. */
   159	    p = (uint8_t *)ptr;
   160	    aligned = (size + 15u) & ~15u;
   161	    if (p + aligned == jit->cache_ptr) {
   162	        jit->cache_ptr = p;
   163	        if (jit->stats.cache_bytes_used >= aligned) {
   164	            jit->stats.cache_bytes_used -= aligned;
   165	        } else {
   166	            jit->stats.cache_bytes_used = 0;
   167	        }
   168	        jit->stats.cache_bytes_free = jit->cache_size - jit->stats.cache_bytes_used;
   169	    }
   170	}
   171	
   172	
   173	/**
   174	 * Flush instruction cache for a region
   175	 * 
   176	 * Ensures that newly generated code is visible to the instruction
   177	 * fetch unit. On AArch64, this requires explicit cache maintenance.
   178	 * 
   179	 * @param jit JIT context
   180	 * @param start Start of region to flush
   181	 * @param size Size of region to flush
   182	 */
   183	void jit_cache_flush(jit_context_t *jit, void *start, size_t size)
   184	{
   185	    if (jit == NULL || start == NULL || size == 0) {
   186	        return;
   187	    }
   188	    
   189	    /* 
   190	     * On AArch64, we need to:
   191	     * 1. Clean data cache to point of unification
   192	     * 2. Invalidate instruction cache to point of unification
   193	     * 
   194	     * For now, we use the __builtin___clear_cache which handles
   195	     * this portably. In production code, you might want inline
   196	     * assembly for better control.
   197	     */
   198	    __builtin___clear_cache((char *)start, (char *)start + size);
   199	}
   200	
   201	
   202	/**
   203	 * Lookup a block by PC
   204	 * 
   205	 * @param jit JIT context
   206	 * @param pc Program counter to look up
   207	 * @return Pointer to block, or NULL if not found
   208	 */
   209	jit_block_t *jit_cache_lookup(jit_context_t *jit, uint32_t pc)
   210	{
   211	    uint32_t hash;
   212	    jit_block_t *block;
   213	    
   214	    /* DEBUG: Instrument lookup for 0x00F80BD4 */
   215	    bool debug_lookup = (pc == 0x00F80BD4);
   216	    if (debug_lookup) {
   217	        LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG] CACHE LOOKUP PC=0x%08X jit=%p\n", pc, (void*)jit);
   218	    }
   219	    
   220	    if (jit == NULL) {
   221	        if (debug_lookup) {
   222	            LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG] CACHE LOOKUP FAILED: jit=NULL\n");
   223	        }
   224	        return NULL;
   225	    }
   226	    
   227	    hash = jit_cache_hash_pc(pc);
   228	    block = jit->hash_table[hash];
   229	    
   230	    if (debug_lookup) {
   231	        LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG] hash=0x%08X table[hash]=%p\n", hash, (void*)block);
   232	    }
   233	    
   234	    while (block != NULL) {
   235	        if (debug_lookup) {
   236	            LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG]   checking block: start_pc=0x%08X flags=0x%04X\n",
   237	                      block->start_pc, block->flags);
   238	        }
   239	        if (block->start_pc == pc && (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_VALID)) {
   240	            if (debug_lookup) {
   241	                LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG] CACHE HIT: block=%p code_ptr=%p\n",
   242	                          (void*)block, (void*)block->code_ptr);
   243	            }
   244	            return block;
   245	        }
   246	        block = block->hash_next;
   247	    }
   248	    
   249	    if (debug_lookup) {
   250	        LOG_ERROR("[JIT-DEBUG] CACHE MISS: no block found\n");
   251	    }
   252	    return NULL;
   253	}
   254	
   255	
   256	/**
   257	 * Insert a block into the cache
   258	 * 
   259	 * @param jit JIT context
   260	 * @param block Block to insert
   261	 */
   262	void jit_cache_insert(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   263	{
   264	    uint32_t hash;
   265	    
   266	    if (jit == NULL || block == NULL) {
   267	        return;
   268	    }
   269	    
   270	    hash = jit_cache_hash_pc(block->start_pc);
   271	    
   272	    /* Insert at head of hash chain */
   273	    block->hash_next = jit->hash_table[hash];
   274	    jit->hash_table[hash] = block;
   275	}
   276	
   277	
   278	/**
   279	 * Remove a block from the cache
   280	 * 
   281	 * @param jit JIT context
   282	 * @param block Block to remove
   283	 */
   284	void jit_cache_remove(jit_context_t *jit, jit_block_t *block)
   285	{
   286	    uint32_t hash;
   287	    jit_block_t *prev, *curr;
   288	    
   289	    if (jit == NULL || block == NULL) {
   290	        return;
   291	    }
   292	    
   293	    hash = jit_cache_hash_pc(block->start_pc);
   294	    prev = NULL;
   295	    curr = jit->hash_table[hash];
   296	    
   297	    while (curr != NULL) {
   298	        if (curr == block) {
   299	            if (prev == NULL) {
   300	                jit->hash_table[hash] = curr->hash_next;
   301	            } else {
   302	                prev->hash_next = curr->hash_next;
   303	            }
   304	            /* Decrement interpret block count if applicable */
   305	            if (block->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   306	                if (jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count > 0) {
   307	                    jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count--;
   308	                }
   309	            }
   310	            return;
   311	        }
   312	        prev = curr;
   313	        curr = curr->hash_next;
   314	    }
   315	}
   316	
   317	
   318	/**
   319	 * Check if we should add an interpret-only block
   320	 * 
   321	 * Returns 1 if OK to add, 0 if limit reached
   322	 * 
   323	 * @param jit JIT context
   324	 * @return 1 if OK to add, 0 if limit reached
   325	 */
   326	int jit_cache_should_add_interpret_block(jit_context_t *jit)
   327	{
   328	    if (jit == NULL) {
   329	        return 0;
   330	    }
   331	    
   332	    if (jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count >= JIT_MAX_INTERPRET_BLOCKS) {
   333	        return 0; /* Limit reached */
   334	    }
   335	    
   336	    return 1;
   337	}
   338	
   339	
   340	/**
   341	 * Evict the oldest interpret-only block
   342	 * 
   343	 * Simple LRU approximation - evicts from the end of a hash chain
   344	 * 
   345	 * @param jit JIT context
   346	 */
   347	void jit_cache_evict_oldest_interpret_block(jit_context_t *jit)
   348	{
   349	    uint32_t i;
   350	    jit_block_t *prev, *curr, *victim = NULL, *victim_prev = NULL;
   351	    uint32_t victim_hash = 0;
   352	    
   353	    if (jit == NULL) {
   354	        return;
   355	    }
   356	    
   357	    /* Find an interpret-only block to evict */
   358	    for (i = 0; i < JIT_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
   359	        prev = NULL;
   360	        curr = jit->hash_table[i];
   361	        
   362	        while (curr != NULL) {
   363	            if (curr->flags & JIT_BLOCK_INTERPRET_ONLY) {
   364	                /* Found an interpret block - evict it */
   365	                victim = curr;
   366	                victim_prev = prev;
   367	                victim_hash = i;
   368	                break;
   369	            }
   370	            prev = curr;
   371	            curr = curr->hash_next;
   372	        }
   373	        
   374	        if (victim) {
   375	            break;
   376	        }
   377	    }
   378	    
   379	    if (victim) {
   380	        /* Remove from hash table */
   381	        if (victim_prev == NULL) {
   382	            jit->hash_table[victim_hash] = victim->hash_next;
   383	        } else {
   384	            victim_prev->hash_next = victim->hash_next;
   385	        }
   386	        
   387	        /* Free the block */
   388	        if (victim->code_ptr != NULL && victim->code_size > 0) {
   389	            jit_cache_free(jit, victim->code_ptr, victim->code_size);
   390	        }
   391	        free(victim);
   392	        
   393	        jit->stats.interpret_blocks_evicted++;
   394	        if (jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count > 0) {
   395	            jit->stats.interpret_blocks_count--;
   396	        }
   397	    }
   398	}
   399	
   400	
   401	/**
   402	 * Get cache bytes used
   403	 * 
   404	 * @param jit JIT context
   405	 * @return Number of bytes used
   406	 */
   407	size_t jit_cache_used(jit_context_t *jit)
   408	{
   409	    if (jit == NULL) {
   410	        return 0;
   411	    }
   412	    return jit->stats.cache_bytes_used;
   413	}
   414	
   415	
   416	/**
   417	 * Get cache bytes free
   418	 * 
   419	 * @param jit JIT context
   420	 * @return Number of bytes free
   421	 */
   422	size_t jit_cache_free_space(jit_context_t *jit)
   423	{
   424	    if (jit == NULL) {
   425	        return 0;
   426	    }
   427	    return jit->stats.cache_bytes_free;
   428	}

    16	void jit_emit_init(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t *buffer, size_t size)
    17	{
    18	    ctx->buffer = buffer;
    19	    ctx->size = size;
    20	    ctx->offset = 0;
    21	    ctx->error = false;
    22	}

    24	void jit_emit_byte(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t byte)
    25	{
    26	    if (ctx->offset >= ctx->size) {
    27	        ctx->error = true;
    28	        return;
    29	    }
    30	    ctx->buffer[ctx->offset++] = byte;
    31	}

    33	void jit_emit_word(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint16_t word)
    34	{
    35	    jit_emit_byte(ctx, word & 0xFF);
    36	    jit_emit_byte(ctx, (word >> 8) & 0xFF);
    37	}

    39	void jit_emit_dword(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint32_t dword)
    40	{
    41	    jit_emit_word(ctx, dword & 0xFFFF);
    42	    jit_emit_word(ctx, (dword >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
    43	}
    44	
    45	void jit_emit_mov64(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t rd, uint64_t imm)
    46	{
    47	    if (imm == 0) {
    48	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR(rd, rd, rd));
    49	        return;
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_MOVZ(rd, imm & 0xFFFF, 0));
    53	
    54	    for (int shift = 16; shift < 64; shift += 16) {
    55	        uint16_t chunk = (imm >> shift) & 0xFFFF;
    56	        if (chunk != 0) {
    57	            jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_MOVK(rd, chunk, shift / 16));
    58	        }
    59	    }
    60	}

   179	    /* Return a positive cycle count so jit_execute() keeps block execution on JIT path. */

   184	void jit_emit_inc_pc(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, int instr_size)
   185	{
   186	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LDR_W(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, JIT_CPU_OFF(pc)));
   187	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R1, instr_size);
   188	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ADD(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R1));
   189	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_STR_W(AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, JIT_CPU_OFF(pc)));
   190	}
