   197	
   198	static void jit_emit_call_read_common(jit_emit_context_t *ctx,
   199	                                      uint8_t dst_reg,
   200	                                      uint8_t addr_reg,
   201	                                      uintptr_t fn_addr)
   202	{
   203	    /* Place address argument in X0/W0. */
   204	    if (addr_reg != AARCH64_R0) {
   205	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R0, addr_reg, addr_reg));
   206	    }
   207	
   208	    /* Indirect call through a scratch register. */
   209	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R6, (uint64_t)fn_addr);
   210	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_BLR(AARCH64_R6));
   211	
   212	    /* Re-anchor CPU pointer register after C helper calls. */
   213	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&m68ki_cpu);
   214	
   215	    /* Move return value from X0/W0 if needed. */
   216	    if (dst_reg != AARCH64_R0) {
   217	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(dst_reg, AARCH64_R0, AARCH64_R0));
   218	    }
   219	}
   220	
   221	void jit_emit_call_read8(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t dst_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   222	{
   223	    jit_emit_call_read_common(ctx, dst_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_read_memory_8);
   224	}
   225	
   226	void jit_emit_call_read16(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t dst_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   227	{
   228	    jit_emit_call_read_common(ctx, dst_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_read_memory_16);
   229	}
   230	
   231	void jit_emit_call_read32(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t dst_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   232	{
   233	    jit_emit_call_read_common(ctx, dst_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_read_memory_32);
   234	}
   235	
   236	static void jit_emit_call_write_common(jit_emit_context_t *ctx,
   237	                                       uint8_t value_reg,
   238	                                       uint8_t addr_reg,
   239	                                       uintptr_t fn_addr)
   240	{
   241	    /* x0/w0 = address, x1/w1 = value */
   242	    if (addr_reg != AARCH64_R0) {
   243	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R0, addr_reg, addr_reg));
   244	    }
   245	    if (value_reg != AARCH64_R1) {
   246	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_ORR(AARCH64_R1, value_reg, value_reg));
   247	    }
   248	
   249	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R6, (uint64_t)fn_addr);
   250	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_BLR(AARCH64_R6));
   251	
   252	    /* Re-anchor CPU pointer register after C helper calls. */
   253	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_CPU_PTR, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&m68ki_cpu);
   254	}
   255	
   256	void jit_emit_call_write8(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t value_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   257	{
   258	    jit_emit_call_write_common(ctx, value_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_write_memory_8);
   259	}
   260	
   261	void jit_emit_call_write16(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t value_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   262	{
   263	    jit_emit_call_write_common(ctx, value_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_write_memory_16);
   264	}
   265	
   266	void jit_emit_call_write32(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t value_reg, uint8_t addr_reg)
   267	{
   268	    jit_emit_call_write_common(ctx, value_reg, addr_reg, (uintptr_t)&m68k_write_memory_32);
   269	}
   270	
   271	void jit_emit_store_nzcv_flags(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, int invert_carry)
   272	{
   273	    const int off_n = JIT_CPU_OFF(n_flag);
   274	    const int off_notz = JIT_CPU_OFF(not_z_flag);
   275	    const int off_v = JIT_CPU_OFF(v_flag);
   276	    const int off_c = JIT_CPU_OFF(c_flag);
   277	    const int off_x = JIT_CPU_OFF(x_flag);
   278	
   279	    /* R3 <= NZCV (bits 31..28 are N,Z,C,V). */
   280	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_MRS_NZCV(AARCH64_R3));
   281	    jit_emit_mov64(ctx, AARCH64_R7, 1);
   282	
   283	    /* n_flag = (N << 7) */
   284	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, 31));
   285	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   286	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, 7));
   287	    jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R4, off_n);
   288	
   289	    /* not_z_flag = !Z (0 when equal, 1 when not equal). */
   290	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, 30));
   291	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   292	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   293	    jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R4, off_notz);
   294	
   295	    /* v_flag = (V << 7) */
   296	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, 28));
   297	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   298	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, 7));
   299	    jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R4, off_v);
   300	
   301	    /* c_flag/x_flag = (C << 8), with optional inversion for SUB/CMP semantics. */
   302	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSR(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R3, 29));
   303	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_AND_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   304	    if (invert_carry) {
   305	        jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_EOR_W(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R7));
   306	    }
   307	    jit_emit_dword(ctx, AARCH64_LSL(AARCH64_R4, AARCH64_R4, 8));
   308	    jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R4, off_c);
   309	    jit_emit_store_cpu_reg(ctx, AARCH64_R4, off_x);
   310	}


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_emit_aarch64.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT AArch64 Emitter Interface
     3	 *
     4	 * Single source of truth:
     5	 * - one emitter context type
     6	 * - one external implementation in jit_emit_aarch64.c
     7	 */
     8	
     9	#ifndef JIT_EMIT_AARCH64_H
    10	#define JIT_EMIT_AARCH64_H
    11	
    12	#include <stdint.h>
    13	#include <stdbool.h>
    14	#include <stddef.h>
    15	
    16	/* AArch64 register assignments for JIT */
    17	#define AARCH64_CPU_PTR   19  /* X19: pointer to m68ki_cpu state (callee-saved) */
    18	#define AARCH64_R0         0
    19	#define AARCH64_R1         1
    20	#define AARCH64_R2         2
    21	#define AARCH64_R3         3
    22	#define AARCH64_R4         4
    23	#define AARCH64_R5         5
    24	#define AARCH64_R6         6
    25	#define AARCH64_R7         7
    26	
    27	typedef struct {
    28	    uint8_t *buffer;
    29	    size_t size;
    30	    size_t offset;
    31	    bool error;
    32	} jit_emit_context_t;
    33	
    34	/* AArch64 Instruction Encodings */
    35	#define AARCH64_MOVZ(rd, imm16, lsl)  (0xD2800000u | ((imm16) << 5) | ((lsl & 3) << 21) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    36	#define AARCH64_MOVK(rd, imm16, lsl)  (0xF2800000u | ((imm16) << 5) | ((lsl & 3) << 21) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    37	
    38	#define AARCH64_LDR_W(rt, rn, imm)    (0xB9400000u | (((imm) >> 2) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    39	#define AARCH64_STR_W(rt, rn, imm)    (0xB9000000u | (((imm) >> 2) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    40	#define AARCH64_LDR(rt, rn, imm)      (0xF9400000u | (((imm) >> 3) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    41	#define AARCH64_STR(rt, rn, imm)      (0xF9000000u | (((imm) >> 3) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    42	
    43	#define AARCH64_LDRB(rt, rn, imm)     (0x39400000u | ((imm) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    44	#define AARCH64_STRB(rt, rn, imm)     (0x39000000u | ((imm) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    45	
    46	#define AARCH64_LDRH(rt, rn, imm)     (0x79400000u | (((imm) >> 1) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    47	#define AARCH64_STRH(rt, rn, imm)     (0x79000000u | (((imm) >> 1) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    48	
    49	#define AARCH64_ADD(rd, rn, rm)       (0x8B000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    50	#define AARCH64_SUB(rd, rn, rm)       (0xCB000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    51	#define AARCH64_ADDS(rd, rn, rm)      (0xAB000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    52	#define AARCH64_SUBS(rd, rn, rm)      (0xEB000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    53	
    54	#define AARCH64_AND(rd, rn, rm)       (0x8A000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    55	#define AARCH64_ORR(rd, rn, rm)       (0xAA000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    56	#define AARCH64_EOR(rd, rn, rm)       (0xCA000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    57	
    58	#define AARCH64_AND_W(rd, rn, rm)     (0x0A000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    59	#define AARCH64_ORR_W(rd, rn, rm)     (0x2A000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    60	#define AARCH64_EOR_W(rd, rn, rm)     (0x4A000000u | ((rm) << 16) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    61	
    62	#define AARCH64_B(imm)                (0x14000000u | ((imm) & 0x03FFFFFF))
    63	#define AARCH64_BL(imm)               (0x94000000u | ((imm) & 0x03FFFFFF))
    64	#define AARCH64_BLR(rn)               (0xD63F0000u | (((rn) & 0x1F) << 5))
    65	#define AARCH64_BCOND(cond, imm)      (0x54000000u | ((cond) & 0xF) | (((imm) & 0x7FFFF) << 5))
    66	#define AARCH64_CBZ(rt, imm)          (0x34000000u | ((((uint32_t)(imm) >> 2) & 0x7FFFFu) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    67	#define AARCH64_CBNZ(rt, imm)         (0x35000000u | ((((uint32_t)(imm) >> 2) & 0x7FFFFu) << 5) | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    68	
    69	#define AARCH64_COND_EQ  0x0
    70	#define AARCH64_COND_NE  0x1
    71	#define AARCH64_COND_CS  0x2
    72	#define AARCH64_COND_CC  0x3
    73	#define AARCH64_COND_MI  0x4
    74	#define AARCH64_COND_PL  0x5
    75	#define AARCH64_COND_VS  0x6
    76	#define AARCH64_COND_VC  0x7
    77	#define AARCH64_COND_HI  0x8
    78	#define AARCH64_COND_LS  0x9
    79	#define AARCH64_COND_GE  0xA
    80	#define AARCH64_COND_LT  0xB
    81	#define AARCH64_COND_GT  0xC
    82	#define AARCH64_COND_LE  0xD
    83	
    84	#define AARCH64_RET                  0xD65F03C0u
    85	#define AARCH64_NOP                  0xD503201Fu
    86	#define AARCH64_MRS_NZCV(rt)         (0xD53B4200u | ((rt) & 0x1F))
    87	#define AARCH64_REV(rd, rn)          (0xDAC00C00u | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    88	#define AARCH64_LSL(rd, rn, shift)   (0x53000000u | ((((32u - ((uint32_t)(shift) & 0x1Fu)) & 0x1Fu)) << 16) | ((((31u - ((uint32_t)(shift) & 0x1Fu)) & 0x1Fu)) << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    89	#define AARCH64_LSR(rd, rn, shift)   (0x53000000u | ((((uint32_t)(shift)) & 0x1Fu) << 16) | (31u << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    90	#define AARCH64_ASR(rd, rn, shift)   (0x13000000u | ((((uint32_t)(shift)) & 0x1Fu) << 16) | (31u << 10) | ((rn) << 5) | ((rd) & 0x1F))
    91	
    92	void jit_emit_init(jit_emit_context_t *ctx, uint8_t *buffer, size_t size);

----- src/m68xkcpu/jit.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Core Header
     3	 * 
     4	 * Main interface for the AArch64 JIT layer.
     5	 */
     6	
     7	#ifndef JIT_H
     8	#define JIT_H
     9	
    10	#include <stdint.h>
    11	#include <stdbool.h>
    12	#include <stddef.h>
    13	#include "generated/jit_68000_opinfo.h"
    14	
    15	/* Forward declarations */
    16	struct m68ki_cpu_core;
    17	
    18	/* JIT cache configuration */
    19	#define JIT_CACHE_SIZE          (16 * 1024 * 1024)  /* 16 MB default */
    20	#define JIT_MAX_BLOCKS          65536
    21	#define JIT_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE      4096                /* Max bytes per compiled block */
    22	#define JIT_HASH_SIZE           4096                /* Hash table size for block lookup */
    23	#define JIT_MAX_INTERPRET_BLOCKS  8192              /* Max interpret-only blocks to prevent unbounded growth */
    24	
    25	/* JIT statistics */
    26	typedef struct {
    27	    uint32_t blocks_compiled;
    28	    uint32_t blocks_executed;
    29	    uint32_t cache_hits;
    30	    uint32_t cache_misses;
    31	    uint32_t fast_step_count;
    32	    uint32_t fallback_count;
    33	    uint32_t cache_invalidations;
    34	    uint32_t interpret_blocks_count;    /* Current count of interpret-only blocks */
    35	    uint32_t interpret_blocks_evicted;  /* Count of evicted interpret-only blocks */
    36	    size_t cache_bytes_used;
    37	    size_t cache_bytes_free;
    38	} jit_stats_t;
    39	
    40	/* JIT block handle */
    41	typedef struct jit_block jit_block_t;
    42	
    43	/* JIT context */
    44	typedef struct {
    45	    /* Cache management */
    46	    uint8_t *cache_base;          /* Base of code cache */
    47	    uint8_t *cache_ptr;           /* Current allocation pointer */
    48	    size_t cache_size;            /* Total cache size */
    49	    
    50	    /* Block lookup */
    51	    jit_block_t *hash_table[JIT_HASH_SIZE];
    52	    
    53	    /* Current execution state */
    54	    jit_block_t *current_block;
    55	    uint32_t current_pc;
    56	    
    57	    /* Statistics */
    58	    jit_stats_t stats;
    59	    
    60	    /* CPU state sync */
    61	    struct m68ki_cpu_core *cpu;
    62	
    63	    /* 68040 MMU tracking for cache safety */
    64	    uint64_t mmu_state_sig;
    65	    bool mmu_state_valid;
    66	    
    67	    /* Flags */
    68	    bool initialized;
    69	    bool enabled;
    70	} jit_context_t;
    71	
    72	/* Global JIT context */
    73	extern jit_context_t g_jit;
    74	
    75	/* Initialization */
    76	int jit_init(struct m68ki_cpu_core *cpu, size_t cache_size);
    77	void jit_shutdown(void);
    78	void jit_reset(void);
    79	
    80	/* Execution */
    81	int jit_execute(uint32_t pc, int cycles);
    82	
    83	/* Hard fail mode - abort on unsupported instructions */
    84	int jit_no_fallback_enabled(void);
    85	void jit_hard_fail(uint32_t pc, uint16_t opcode, const char *reason);
    86

    88	void jit_invalidate_range(uint32_t start_addr, uint32_t end_addr);
    89	void jit_invalidate_all(void);

    92	void jit_print_stats(void);

----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_mem_pistorm.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT PiStorm Memory Backend
     3	 * 
     4	 * Real Amiga memory access via PiStorm backend for the emulator.
     5	 * 
     6	 * This is used when the JIT runs in the actual PiStorm hardware environment.
     7	 */
     8	
     9	#ifndef JIT_MEM_PISTORM_H
    10	#define JIT_MEM_PISTORM_H
    11	
    12	#include <stdint.h>
    13	#include "../pistorm/backend.h"
    14	
    15	/* ======================================================================== */
    16	/* ====================== PiStorm Backend Memory Access =================== */
    17	/* ======================================================================== */
    18	
    19	/* 
    20	 * Real Amiga memory access via PiStorm backend.
    21	 * Handles:
    22	 * - Big Endian ↔ Little Endian conversion
    23	 * - Function codes (FC0-FC2)
    24	 * - Bus timing and hardware behavior
    25	 */
    26	
    27	static inline int jit_mem_read8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint8_t *value)
    28	{
    29	    return ps_backend_read8(addr, fc, value);
    30	}
    31	
    32	static inline int jit_mem_read16(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint16_t *value)
    33	{
    34	    return ps_backend_read16(addr, fc, value);
    35	}
    36	
    37	static inline int jit_mem_read32(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint32_t *value)
    38	{
    39	    return ps_backend_read32(addr, fc, value);
    40	}
    41	
    42	static inline int jit_mem_write8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t value, uint8_t fc)
    43	{
    44	    return ps_backend_write8(addr, value, fc);
    45	}
    46	
    47	static inline int jit_mem_write16(uint32_t addr, uint16_t value, uint8_t fc)
    48	{
    49	    return ps_backend_write16(addr, value, fc);
    50	}
    51	
    52	static inline int jit_mem_write32(uint32_t addr, uint32_t value, uint8_t fc)
    53	{
    54	    return ps_backend_write32(addr, value, fc);
    55	}
    56	
    57	/* ======================================================================== */
    58	/* ====================== Instruction Fetch =============================== */
    59	/* ======================================================================== */
    60	
    61	/* 
    62	 * Fetch instruction from PC.
    63	 * In real hardware, this may involve prefetch buffers.
    64	 */
    65	
    66	static inline uint16_t jit_fetch_word(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc)
    67	{
    68	    uint16_t value;
    69	    ps_backend_read16(pc, fc, &value);
    70	    return value;
    71	}
    72	
    73	static inline uint32_t jit_fetch_long(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc)
    74	{
    75	    uint32_t value;
    76	    ps_backend_read32(pc, fc, &value);
    77	    return value;
    78	}
    79	
    80	#endif /* JIT_MEM_PISTORM_H */


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_mem_test.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Test Memory Model
     3	 * 
     4	 * Flat, deterministic memory for ProcessorTests validation harness.
     5	 * 
     6	 * NO PiStorm backend. NO hardware. NO memory map complexity.
     7	 * 
     8	 * This provides a clean oracle for instruction semantics validation.
     9	 */
    10	
    11	#ifndef JIT_MEM_TEST_H
    12	#define JIT_MEM_TEST_H
    13	
    14	#include <stdint.h>
    15	#include <string.h>
    16	
    17	/* ======================================================================== */
    18	/* ====================== Test Memory Configuration ======================= */
    19	/* ======================================================================== */
    20	
    21	/* Flat 16MB memory space - enough for all ProcessorTests */
    22	#define JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE (16 * 1024 * 1024)
    23	
    24	/* Test memory context - one per test case */
    25	typedef struct {
    26	    uint8_t ram[JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE];
    27	    uint32_t ram_initialized;  /* Bitmask of initialized 256KB blocks */
    28	} jit_test_mem_t;
    29	
    30	/* Global test memory (set before each test) */
    31	extern jit_test_mem_t *g_jit_test_mem;
    32	
    33	/* ======================================================================== */
    34	/* ====================== Memory Initialization =========================== */
    35	/* ======================================================================== */
    36	
    37	static inline void jit_test_mem_init(jit_test_mem_t *mem)
    38	{
    39	    memset(mem, 0, sizeof(*mem));
    40	    g_jit_test_mem = mem;
    41	}
    42	
    43	static inline void jit_test_mem_load(jit_test_mem_t *mem, uint32_t addr, const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size)
    44	{
    45	    if (addr + size <= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) {
    46	        memcpy(mem->ram + addr, data, size);
    47	        mem->ram_initialized |= (1u << (addr >> 18));  /* Mark 256KB block as initialized */
    48	    }
    49	}
    50	
    51	/* ======================================================================== */
    52	/* ====================== Memory Access (Flat, No Backend) ================ */
    53	/* ======================================================================== */
    54	
    55	/* 
    56	 * Direct memory access - no PiStorm backend, no hardware.
    57	 * Function codes are ignored in test mode (no MMU, no protection).
    58	 */
    59	
    60	static inline int jit_mem_read8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint8_t *value)
    61	{
    62	    (void)fc;  /* Ignored in test mode */
    63	    if (addr >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
    64	    *value = g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr];
    65	    return 0;
    66	}
    67	
    68	static inline int jit_mem_read16(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint16_t *value)
    69	{
    70	    (void)fc;
    71	    if (addr + 1 >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
    72	    *value = (g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr] << 8) | g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 1];
    73	    return 0;
    74	}
    75	
    76	static inline int jit_mem_read32(uint32_t addr, uint8_t fc, uint32_t *value)
    77	{
    78	    (void)fc;
    79	    if (addr + 3 >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
    80	    *value = (g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr] << 24) | 
    81	             (g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 1] << 16) |
    82	             (g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 2] << 8) |
    83	             g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 3];
    84	    return 0;
    85	}
    86	
    87	static inline int jit_mem_write8(uint32_t addr, uint8_t value, uint8_t fc)
    88	{
    89	    (void)fc;
    90	    if (addr >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
    91	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr] = value;
    92	    return 0;
    93	}
    94	
    95	static inline int jit_mem_write16(uint32_t addr, uint16_t value, uint8_t fc)
    96	{
    97	    (void)fc;
    98	    if (addr + 1 >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
    99	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr] = value >> 8;
   100	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 1] = value & 0xFF;
   101	    return 0;
   102	}
   103	
   104	static inline int jit_mem_write32(uint32_t addr, uint32_t value, uint8_t fc)
   105	{
   106	    (void)fc;
   107	    if (addr + 3 >= JIT_TEST_MEM_SIZE) return -1;
   108	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr] = value >> 24;
   109	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 1] = (value >> 16) & 0xFF;
   110	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 2] = (value >> 8) & 0xFF;
   111	    g_jit_test_mem->ram[addr + 3] = value & 0xFF;
   112	    return 0;
   113	}
   114	
   115	/* ======================================================================== */
   116	/* ====================== Instruction Fetch =============================== */
   117	/* ======================================================================== */
   118	
   119	static inline uint16_t jit_fetch_word(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc)
   120	{
   121	    uint16_t value;
   122	    jit_mem_read16(pc, fc, &value);
   123	    return value;
   124	}
   125	
   126	static inline uint32_t jit_fetch_long(uint32_t pc, uint8_t fc)
   127	{
   128	    uint32_t value;
   129	    jit_mem_read32(pc, fc, &value);
   130	    return value;
   131	}
   132	
   133	#endif /* JIT_MEM_TEST_H */


----- src/m68xkcpu/jit_translate.h -----

     1	/*
     2	 * JIT Translator Interface
     3	 *
     4	 * Single source of truth:
     5	 * - block-based translation
     6	 * - one translator context type (jit_translate_context_t)
     7	 * - external AArch64 emitter implementation
     8	 */
     9	
    10	#ifndef JIT_TRANSLATE_H
    11	#define JIT_TRANSLATE_H
    12	
    13	#include <stdint.h>
    14	#include "jit.h"
    15	#include "jit_emit_aarch64.h"
    16	
    17	typedef struct {
    18	    jit_context_t *jit;
    19	    jit_block_t *block;
    20	    jit_emit_context_t *emit;
    21	    uint16_t opcode;
    22	    uint16_t *ext_words;
    23	    int ext_count;
    24	    uint16_t instruction_index;
    25	} jit_translate_context_t;
    26	
    27	typedef int (*jit_translator_fn)(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    28	
    29	int jit_translate_nop(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    30	int jit_translate_moveq(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    31	int jit_translate_move(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    32	int jit_translate_add(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    33	int jit_translate_addq(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    34	int jit_translate_sub(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    35	int jit_translate_subq(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    36	int jit_translate_cmp(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    37	int jit_translate_logic(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    38	int jit_translate_branch(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    39	int jit_translate_bsr(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    40	int jit_translate_rts(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    41	int jit_translate_jsr(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    42	int jit_translate_jmp(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    43	int jit_translate_movec(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    44	int jit_translate_extb(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    45	int jit_translate_lea(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    46	int jit_translate_misc(jit_translate_context_t *ctx);
    47	
    48	#endif /* JIT_TRANSLATE_H */
